author: Julius Gavroche
title: Giorgio Agamben: The death of the word?
content:
Michelangelo,

Cumaean Sibyl

 (c. 1511), Sistine Chapel, Vatican City


This short article was originally published under the title “Morte della parola?” in the Italian newspaper

Paese Sera

 on 8 February 1968. It has been republished in the latest issue of the French magazine

Entétement

, although the original version can be found on the

La Voce di Fiore

 archive website. A Spanish translation of the same can be found at th magazine

Ficción de la razón

.


A book has recently been published in Paris,

Of Grammatology

 (1967), a work destined to cause a stir not only in the field of linguistic studies. Jacques Derrida, one of the most original figures in the new wave of French philosophical criticism, begins with the observation that, today, “through a movement whose necessity we can barely glimpse, everything that, for at least twenty centuries, has tended to be defined under the name of language, is beginning to be summarised under the name of writing”. It does indeed seem that writing—which, according to Rousseau, was nothing more than a complement to speech—is gradually freeing itself from its subordination to the phonetic medium, to the point of reversing its traditional relationship with language: writing would therefore not be a technique in the service of language, but rather, on the contrary, it is language that can be considered a specific case, an aspect, of writing.


To better understand the phenomenon to which Derrida refers when he speaks of writing dissociated from the phonetic element, one need only consider the example of mathematics, whose symbolic notation does not refer to any spoken language. If we consider that today we are witnessing a process of mathematisation across all the sciences, the “liberation” of writing described by Derrida becomes an extremely concrete phenomenon (readers who have followed recent news regarding the

in vitro

 synthesis of living matter, carried out by certain American scientists, will recall having heard talk of writing and “programmes” even in relation to the most elementary processes of the living cell). The “liberation” of writing described by Derrida becomes an extremely concrete phenomenon.


On the basis of these premises, Derrida deduces the need for a pure science of writing, which considers writing prior to speech and independently of it: this science is, precisely, “grammatology”; and, to define its aims, it suffices to substitute this term for “semiology”, the term Saussure uses to outline the programme of his famous

Course in General Linguistics

: “We shall call it grammatology… and, as it does not yet exist, we cannot say what it will be; but it has a right to exist, and its place is determined in advance”. The age of speech, which began under the creative power of the verb, is drawing to a close before our very eyes; the character of this new age might be summed up in the following formula: “In the beginning was the written word’’.


Whilst it is true that, from this perspective, linguistics must become a mere branch of grammatology, Derrida seems, however, to overlook the fact that a science already exists which considers language not as speech, but as code and writing; consequently, grammatology itself should necessarily be understood as a sub-branch or a section of that science. This is cybernetics, which, from its beginnings in Wiener’s theories, defined its world as a universe of writing and coding. The very idea of grammatology is already fully contained within the notion of “programme”, one of the key concepts of cybernetics. Etymologically, “programme” —pro-grammer— means “to put the letter (that is,

writing

) first”, whilst “prophecy” means, by contrast, “to put the word first”. Indeed, in the programme assigned to an electronic brain, everything that constitutes the living, phonetic element of language is erased to make way for a system of absolute writing that can be deciphered but not pronounced. It is fair to say that, up to now, our civilisation has known two types of language that have gradually diverged: the language of science is, essentially, written language —code, writing—, whilst the language of poetry and philosophical thought is spoken language —breath, word—. Nevertheless, these two domains—which, for convenience’s sake, we might call the “sphere of the programme” and the “sphere of prophecy”—are drawing ever closer together today thanks to cybernetics; through the mathematisation of human phenomena, cybernetics …

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: Harassment won’t stop a son’s search for his missing father
content:
Marklen Lariosa, son of missing Kilusang Mayo Uno (KMU) labor organizer William Lariosa, speaks during a rally in Davao City on the first anniversary of his father’s disappearance on April 10, 2025. Photo by Kath Cortez/Davao Today

“Family members searching for their disappeared loved ones have to endure threats and harassment from state forces on top of the terrible uncertainty and emotional turmoil they are already going through.”

Is it a mistake for a son to demand justice and accountability?

Marklen, son of disappeared labor organizer William Lariosa, raised this question following the recent incident of harassment and surveillance he experienced. Members of his family were alarmed after two unidentified individuals were looking for his residence on the night of October 25.

He told Bulatlat that this was the first time such an event had happened since his father, a labor organizer under Kilusang Mayo Uno (KMU) Southern Mindanao, was abducted in Quezon, Bukidnon, on April 10, 2024.

Marklen could not think of other possible reasons, suspecting that the incident may have something to do with his continuing involvement in campaigns and mobilizations that demand the surfacing of Lariosa. “Is it a mistake for a son to search for his missing father?” he further asked.

Read: After 2 years, son laments continuing disappearance of Mindanao labor organizer

Neighbors of the Lariosa family in their hometown in Davao de Oro province were the ones who encountered the two individuals. They reportedly wore helmets and were on board a black motorcycle, introducing themselves as “collectors” when they were asked.

For Marklen, the response and presence of the two raised suspicions. Aside from the fact that they visited the community around 7 p.m., which is outside the regular working hours, Marklen said that he did not apply for any financial loan.

After the incident, he was concerned for the safety of his family, prompting them to lodge a blotter report with the barangay. However, he stood firm that it won’t stop him from continuing his cause.

Desaparecidos, an organization of families and friends of enforced disappearance victims, denounced the incident, urging the government to put an end to this kind of harassment.

“Family members searching for their disappeared loved ones have to endure threats and harassment from state forces on top of the terrible uncertainty and emotional turmoil they are already going through,” JL Burgos, Desaparecidos chairperson, said in a statement.

Rights groups Karapatan and the Center for Trade Union and Human Rights (CTUHR) also expressed strong condemnations about what happened.

Marklen, a member of the National Board of Desaparecidos, has raised a possibility that the two individuals who recently visited their neighborhood might be connected to those who visited their house several times prior to the disappearance of his father.

He said they were visited by individuals who allegedly introduced themselves as state agents once in 2022 and three times in 2023, accusing Lariosa of being involved in communist insurgency. There were warnings, he added, that they would get dragged into it if they would not cooperate.

The series of visits was reportedly the primary reason why Lariosa was forced to take refuge in Bukidnon. Marklen affirmed that his father, who remains missing, had been a labor organizer.

On July 8, the Supreme Court required certain commanders and elements of Philippine Army units to comment on the petition for review on certiorari filed by the family.

Read: Military ordered to reply to missing Mindanao labor organizer’s case

Since 2024, KMU Southern Mindanao has documented 57 cases of human rights violations against its members and organizers.

The labor group released a statement on October 24, presenting the faces of some individuals, including former high-ranking New People’s Army (NPA) member Roberto Rosete Jr., who allegedly harassed KMU’s leaders and members.

Read: Groups decry surveillance of KMU office in Southern Mindanao

Marklen called for an end to any form of harassment and intimidation against families of the disappeared, pointing out that achieving justice is their only goal. (RVO)

author: Shan Kenshin Ecaldre
title: Peasant organizer persists despite surveillance
content:
Jesus Monasterial. (Photo from Photo from Tanggol Magsasaka-TK)

Repeated surveillance restricted his movements and caused anxiety over his family’s safety.

When he was a university student, he questioned the purpose of agricultural education. Now he is organizing landless farmers and fisherfolk.

Jesus Monasterial has spent more than two years working with rural communities in Southern Tagalog. However, his work resulted in repeated surveillance by state forces, peasant groups said.

On October 31, Tanggol Magsasaka–Timog Katagalugan reported that a police intelligence operative identified as “Bruno” had been asking about Monasterial’s whereabouts in Lian, Batangas. The operative was reportedly previously assigned in Nasugbu.

At the time, Monasterial was assisting a protest camp in Barangay San Diego, where farmers, fisherfolk, and residents opposed the possible demolition of several houses.

“I was on my way back to the people’s protest camp in San Diego when news reached us that someone had been asking about my personal information,” he said.

The camp was established by Samahang Mangangawil 1979 and the San Diego Homeowners’ Association, with support from the Katipunan ng mga Samahang Magbubukid sa Timog Katagalugan (KASAMA-TK) and Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas–Timog Katagalugan (PAMALAKAYA-TK).

The incident prompted fellow organizers to discuss security measures. They also plan to file a complaint before the Commission on Human Rights (CHR).

Monasterial’s involvement in peasant organizing began at the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) where he was enrolled in BS Agricultural Biotechnology.

Coming from a family of farmers in Bicol, where his grandparents worked as agricultural tenants, he became increasingly critical of an agricultural education system that he said served the interests of transnational corporations rather than addressing farmers’ lack of land and government support.

Through the League of Filipino Students–UPLB, he became involved in social issues action and joined community immersions with farmers in Tartaria, Silang, Cavite, as well as Mangyan communities in Mindoro and Dumagat communities in Rizal.

These experiences led him to leave his studies and become a full-time organizer. He now serves as deputy secretary-general of KASAMA-TK.

His work involves staying in communities, conducting consultations and political education, and helping establish local farmers and fisherfolk associations.

“Being a full-time organizer means devoting my entire time to the communities and being far from my loved ones,” he said, adding that he had to set aside his plan to finish college.

The October 31 incident was not the first reported surveillance involving Monasterial.

On July 19, 2026, soldiers from the 16th Infantry Battalion of the Philippine Army reportedly sought to identify the organizers of KASAMA-TK’s Regional Peasant Consultation in Barangay Malinis, Lemery, Batangas.

On September 21, a man introducing himself as “Del” Dela Cruz reportedly approached a member of Sugarfolks’ Unity for Genuine Agricultural Reform (SUGAR-Batangas), attempting to persuade the member to leave the organization and provide information about its activities.

According to Tanggol Magsasaka–Timog Katagalugan, the man showed footage of a protest outside the Department of Agriculture regional office led by the Alyansa ng Magsasaka para sa Kumpensasyon (AMK), SUGAR-Batangas, KAISAHAN, and KASAMA-TK. He allegedly warned the member against working with Monasterial, claiming that the organizer was “already drawing attention.”

The protest resulted in a dialogue with government representatives to demand agricultural inputs and implements for farmers and farmworkers affected by successive calamities.

The groups also cited previous incidents in Barangay Casile, Laguna; Lupang Ramos and Tartaria, Cavite; and Coron, Palawan.

Monasterial said that the repeated surveillance restricted his movements and caused anxiety over his family’s safety. “Repeated surveillance limits my movements as an organizer and makes me fear returning home to my family because they might also be targeted by the state due to my advocacy.”

Despite the threats, Monasterial said that his work remains rooted in the struggles of farmers and farmworkers.

title: Habiter au corps d'un âne mort ou le chemin de Nietzsche
content:
Dans la continuité des très nombreux articles que nous avons publiés afin de déchiffrer l'Intelligence artificielle, le monde qu'elle avale, celui qu'elle charrie et celui qu'elle produit, nous partageons cette semaine l'épatante découverte d'Olivier Chiran et Pierre Muzin. . » Première apparition de ces deux lettres, longtemps avant Dartmouth. Évidence de leur rapprochement – en même temps que, d'un simple tiret, de leur mise à distance. On pourrait s'étonner que les traducteurs français (Henri Albert en 1903, Geneviève Bianquis en 1969) aient fait le choix, au lieu du « hi-han » conventionnel, de les conserver telles quelles. Mais le texte allemand dit bien : «

Immer I-A sagen – das lernte allein der Esel, und wer seines Geistes ist

 ! » – Nietzche ayant délibérément fait tomber le

h

 de «

iah

 », braiment de l'âne dans la langue de Goethe. Nous dirons donc, quant à nous, que l'histoire de l'I-A commence à la fin du xixe siècle, lorsqu'un philosophe visionnaire, cheminant à flanc de montagne, a compris qu'on pouvait arracher au cri de l'âne sa puissance d'exclamation intempestive – et qu'il y avait là, pour nous, un grand danger

 [

2

]

.


3.


C'est qu'il y a deux ânes. Gilles Deleuze, commentant les propos de Nietzsche : « On aurait pu croire que l'âne, l'animal qui dit I-A, était l'animal dionysiaque par excellence. En fait, il n'en est rien ; son apparence est dionysiaque, mais toute sa réalité est chrétienne

. » Le braiment sans son ou ses

h

, c'est cette manière qu'a l'âne de dire toujours oui – mais un faux oui, une fausse affirmation qui ne sait pas dire non, qui ne sait qu'acquiescer face à ce qui est. Bêtise. Démission de la pensée. Obscurantisme. Post-vérité. Positivisme logique. (Margaret Thatcher : «

There is no alternative

 » → TINA : « I-A ! I-A ! ») Toutes choses contre lesquelles, justement, la philosophie s'évertue à lutter. « Le réel tel qu'il est, conclut Deleuze, c'est une idée d'âne. »


4.


Il arrive aussi, on le sait, que l'âne se cabre. L'I-A approbatif que dénoncent les philosophes est la forme mutilée de ce « hi-han ! » qui est à la fois refus catégorique et cri pour l'autonomie et la liberté. Entre les deux, il y a toute la différence entre l'âne vivant (dionysiaque) et l'âne mort (chrétien) – entre l'appel à la révolte et le bourdon béat de la fanfare. (« Si l'âne contribue peu à l'harmonie durant sa vie, écrivait-on au milieu du xixe siècle, il la sert généreusement après sa mort, lui fournissant les meilleures peaux qui existent pour les grosses caisses et les meilleurs tibias pour fabriquer des clarinettes

]

. »)


5.


Dans

L'Âne

, de Lucius de Patras, le narrateur voit une magicienne se transformer en oiseau après s'être frotté le corps avec un onguent

. Ayant voulu l'imiter, il se retrouve, quant à lui, métamorphosé en âne. Séquestré par une bande de brigands, il tente de leur échapper en emportant avec lui, dans sa fuite, une jeune prisonnière. Par malchance, les brigands retrouvent les fuyard

title: Lieblingsstreberin: Paula Saunders
content:
In der Apple-TV-Serie „Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed“ gerät Tatiana Maslany als geschiedene Mutter in einen Scam aus Cybersex, Erpressung und Verschwörung.

Geschiedene Soccer Mom, gewissenhafte Fact-Checkerin, falsch Verdächtigte? Paula Saunders (Tatiana Maslany), Protagonistin der Apple-TV-Serie „Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed“, lässt sich auf kein Label festlegen. Sie jongliert mit einem Sorgerechtsstreit und einem schlecht bezahlten Medien-Vollzeitjob – worüber sie sich beim Online-Sexarbeiter Trevor ausheult, der ihr empathisch zuhört, solange sie ihn bezahlt. Bis Trevor plötzlich bei ihrer Camsex-Session entführt wird. Kurze Zeit später kriegt sie einen Anruf, dass sie 15.000 Dollar zahlen soll, um ihn freizukaufen. Von der Polizei wird sie mit dem Hinweis, dass das sicher Betrug ist, abgewimmelt. Als sie nicht zahlt, wird sie mit Cybersex-Aufnahmen erpresst. Da das Sorgerecht für ihre Tochter auf dem Spiel steht, nimmt sie die Sache selbst in die Hand und spürt anhand von ein paar wackeligen Screenshots und einer Überweisung die Erpresser*innen auf. Sie beherrscht alle Techniken der Open-Source-Recherche, ist kreativ und fokussiert, wenn es darum geht, die Fakten herauszufinden. Bis die Frage aufkommt: Wer sind eigentlich die Scammer hinter Trevor? Während die Darstellung von Online-Sexarbeiter*innen als „Scammer“ klischeehaft ausfällt, finden sich alle menschlichen Ambivalenzen in Paulas Charakter wieder, was sicher auch Tatiana Maslanys schauspielerischem Können zu verdanken ist. Paula wird von einer Mischung aus Erpressung, Gewalt und Tatendrang weiter in den Scam hineingezogen, bis sie der ziemlich nutzlosen Polizei immer verdächtiger erscheint. Dabei will Paula nach eigenen Angaben nur eine gute Mutter sein und legt sich dafür regelmäßig mit ihrem Ex-Mann Karl (Jake Johnson) an. Neben all dem coacht sie die Fußballmannschaft ihrer Tochter bis zum Gewinn und scheint immer kurz vor einer Beförderung zu stehen. Wenn sie nur ihre Unschuld beweisen und die große Verschwörung aufdecken könnte, die sie in die Situation gebracht hat … Die Serie „Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed“ ist auf Apple TV verfügbar, eine zweite Staffel ist geplant. author: Unknown
title: Torino: sesto weekend di fila di mobilitazione contro il carovita di guerra!
content:
Ripubblichiamo il comunicato di

Torino contro il riarmo

 sulla giornata di sciopero generale.


Torino è stata attraversata da una giornata di sciopero generale che ha portato in piazza almeno 50 mila persone, di cui 20 mila nello spezzone sociale, formato da: studenti medi, universitari, lavoratori, sindacati di base, comitati di insegnanti, gruppi autonomi di lavoratori,comitati contro i data center e ambientalisti. 


Alle 9 e 30 piazza XVIII dicembre era gremita di persone e il corteo, per riuscire a partire tanti erano i manifestanti, ha dovuto aspettare fino alle 11 per riuscire a muoversi. 


L’entusiasmo di una giornata di sciopero generale si è respirato fin dal primo momento, in molti hanno pensato allo sciopero del 3 ottobre del 2025, in molti hanno iniziano piacevolmente ad abituarsi, che si può scendere in strada in tanti e bloccare davvero la metropoli. 


Per raggiungere la piazza ci sono stati almeno una decina di pre concentramenti fra scuole, università e quartieri, ed un altro corteo studentesco, con la partecipazione del sindacato usb è partito da Piazza Arbarello per contribuire a bloccare la città arrivando fino a confindustria. 


Lo spezzone sociale ha visto alternarsi al microfono una miriade di voci differenti capaci di rappresentare l’anima e lo spirito della città che non si arrende e che combatte contro il carovita di guerra. Dalle Valli di Lanzo, dalla Val di Susa, fino a Barriera di Milano ogni presa di parola ha saputo contribuire a costruire la direzione comune della lotta. 


Una volta arrivati in corso Vittorio lo spezzone sociale non ha voluto accontentarsi del misero percorso concordato dalla CGIL ma ha voluto continuare, dribblando sapientemente i blocchi dei reparti celere e dell’idrante, fino a giungere dopo una lunga marcia fino all’imbocco della autostrada sud. Lì un ingente dispiegamento di polizia con l’idrante ha impedito ai manifestanti di salire sulla rampa autostradale, ma ha di fatto bloccato la circolazione regalando un gol di sponda a chi ha marciato per ore per raggiungere corso Trieste a Moncalieri. 


Tornati indietro verso piazza Bengasi, il corteo si è sciolto, ma per riconvocarsi nuovamente alle 18 in piazza Castello, ormai luogo simbolo della mobilitazione contro il carovita e delle lotte cittadine. Dopo un momento festoso, in cui un coro autorganizzato si è esibito in omaggio alla mobilitazione, il corteo è partito più determinato che mai per le vie del centro cittadino, cercando di sbaragliare, e riuscendoci più volte, i reparti celere e dei carabinieri. In via Accademia Albertina la polizia ha dovuto respingere più tentativi di sfondamento da parte del corteo, come in via della Rocca e su corso Cairoli. Il corteo ha proseguito su corso Casale ritornando verso piazza Vittorio e bloccando il traffico serale. Sul ponte della Gran Madre idrante e celerini si sono scontrati con la determinazione del corteo ad oltrepassare nuovamente il P,o dovendo ricorrere all’uso dei lacrimogeni. Con grande entusiasmo e voglia di continuare la lotta, ci si è lasciati in piazza Borromini con la promessa di rincontrarsi il giorno seguente per il compleanno dei 30 anni di Askatasuna in piazza Santa Giulia. 


Da più di un mese un enorme numero di persone sta scendendo in strada a manifestare contro il carovita e il riarmo ogni fine settimana, il 20 novembre è il sesto di fila. Un fatto inedito, e meraviglioso, il 28 sarà il settimo e in pochi hanno voglia di fermarsi!


La piazza è il luogo in cui ci ritroviamo per lottare ma anche per conoscerci e organizzarci. Le scuole e le università occupate ci hanno insegnato come si strappa il potere di mano a chi comanda le nostre vite e come lo si trasforma in qualcosa di diverso e al servizio dei nostri bisogni. 


Noi la guerra non la paghiamo!


Il governo Meloni se ne deve andare, tutti i governi se ne devono andare, il futuro possiamo costruirlo insieme senza di loro.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Birds of War": New Film Tells a Story of Love and Journalism from Syria to Lebanon
content:
We speak with Janay Boulos and Abd Alkader Habak, filmmakers and subjects of the new documentary

Birds of War

, which tells their epic love story through years of upheaval in the Middle East. Boulos, a London-based Lebanese journalist working for the

BBC

, and Habak, a Syrian activist and cameraman, first connected while covering the Syrian civil war and stayed in touch through years of war, revolution and exile, forming a relationship that is chronicled in the documentary by drawing on 13 years of their personal videos, voice notes and other correspondence.


The film also examines the unequal relationship between international news organizations and local journalists whose work they rely on, the fraught political history between Syria and Lebanon, and how Boulos and Habak’s personal connection overcame those divisions.


“Without our journalistic relationship, [we] would have never been together. I would have never opened my heart to somebody like him,” says Boulos. “We can be any race, any gender, any religion, any background, but at the same time we’re all humans.”


Birds of War

 premiered at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival, where it won the World Cinema Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact.

title: Yeni Parti’li Murat Emir: “İzleme Komisyonu kararı, barış irademizde bir değişiklik anlamına gelmez”
content:
Yeni Parti Grup Başkanvekili Murat Emir, partisinin Meclis bünyesinde kurulması planlanan İzleme Komisyonu'na üye vermeme kararına ilişkin kapsamlı bir açıklama yayımladı. Emir sosyal medya hesabından yayımladığı açıklamada, komisyonda yer almama kararının barış iradesinden vazgeçildiği anlamına gelmeyeceğini vurguladı.

Emir, "Barışa verdiğimiz destek, iktidarın her tercihine peşinen verilmiş onay olarak anlaşılamaz. Demokratikleşmenin ertelenmesine itirazımız da toplumsal barıştan vazgeçtiğimiz anlamına gelmez. Şehit ailelerinin ve gazilerimizin hassasiyetlerini, çatışmalarda evladını kaybetmiş ailelerin acısını, yıllardır adalet bekleyenlerin sesini aynı sorumlulukla dikkate alıyoruz" ifadelerini kullandı. Barışın pazarlık konusu yapılamayacağını ancak demokrasi olmadan da kalıcı barışın kurulamayacağını vurgulayan Emir, iktidarın anayasal yükümlülüklerini sürecin sonuna ertelemesine tepki gösterdi.

Demokratikleşmenin artık ertelenemeyeceğini vurgulayan Emir, “Barış pazarlık konusu yapılamaz ancak, demokrasi olmadan da kalıcı barışın kurulamayacağı unutulmamalıdır. Silahların susmasını hiçbir siyasi pazarlığın şartına bağlamıyoruz. Aynı şekilde, Anayasa’nın uygulanmasının ve yurttaşların haklarına kavuşmasının da bir pazarlığın sonucuna ertelenmesini kabul etmiyoruz” vurgusu yaptı.

Kalıcı barışın demokratik güvencelerini istemenin, silahsızlanmanın önüne yeni bir şart koymak olmadığını belirten Emir, “İktidarın zaten yerine getirmekle yükümlü olduğu sorumluluklar barışın ön şartı olamayacağı gibi, mahkeme kararlarına uymak için veya kayyım uygulamasına artık son vermek için sürecin tamamlanması beklenemez. Basın ve ifade özgürlüğünün önündeki engellerin kaldırılması, iktidarın uygun zaman geldiğinde sunacağı bir imkân olarak görülemez. Biz, toplumsal barış umudunun otoriter uygulamalara gerekçe yapılmasına itiraz ediyoruz. Barışı savunmanın bedeli, hukuksuzluklar karşısında susmak olmamalıdır” ifadelerini kullandı.

Komisyon raporunun 6.5’inci bölümünde yer alan, yürütme içinde bir izleme mekanizması oluşturulması ve hazırlanacak raporların TBMM’ye sunulmasının öngörüldüğünü hatırlatan Emir şu ifadelere yer verdi:

“Bu bölümde, milletvekillerinden oluşacak yeni bir izleme komisyonu kurulması önerisi bulunmamaktadır. Rapordaki ifade açıktır: Yürütme tarafından bu konuda hazırlanacak raporların TBMM’ye sunulması gerekli görülmektedir. 6.1’inci bölümde ise tespit ve teyidin nesnel, ölçülebilir ve denetlenebilir ölçütlerle, şeffaf biçimde yürütülmesi istenmektedir. Sonradan kabul edilen 7595 sayılı Kanun’un 7’nci maddesinin beşinci fıkrasında Meclis bünyesinde İzleme Komisyonu kurulması düzenlenmiştir. Raporun önerileri ile sonradan kanunlaştırılan hükümleri birbirine karıştırmadan konuşmak gerekir.”

Yeni Parti’nin Çerçeve Yasa’ya verdiği desteğin, silahların susması için üstlenilen sorumluluğun gereği olarak tanımlayan Emir, “Bu destek, yasanın uygulanışına ilişkin eleştiri ve denetim hakkımızdan vazgeçtiğimiz anlamına gelmez. Yeni kurulması planlanan İzleme Komisyonu’na ilişkin kararımız da bu siyasi sorumluluk içinde değerlendirilmelidir. Aynı raporun yedinci bölümünde AYM ve AİHM kararlarına uyulması, ifade ve basın özgürlüğünün güçlendirilmesi, infazda adalet, siyasi partilerin kurumsal kimliklerinin korunması ve görevden uzaklaştırılan belediye başkanlarının yerine belediye meclislerinin seçim yapması yönünde öneriler de bulunmaktadır. İktidar temsilcilerinin de kabul ettiği bu öneriler, raporun ayrılmaz parçasıdır. Altıncı bölümü uygularken yedinci bölümü belirsiz bir geleceğe bırakamazsınız. Biz imzamızın sorumluluğunu taşıyoruz. Aynı sorumluluğu, rapora imza atan herkesten bekliyoruz” ifadelerine yer verdi.

YENİ Parti’nin İzleme Komisyonu’na üye vermeme kararı, barış irademizde bir değişiklik anlamına gelmemektedir. Silahların susması, şiddetin sona ermesi ve Türkiye’nin bütün yurttaşları için huzurlu bir geleceğin kurulması için bugüne kadar sorumluluk aldık; aynı sorumlulukla hareket etmeyi sürdürüyoruz. author: Rizomatica
title: 159 años de la creación del fuerte militar de Collipulli y una violencia simbólica que nadie quiere ver pero que todos ven
content:
Por estos días de noviembre se conmemora el aniversario de la comuna y pueblo de Collipulli. Precisamente el 22 de noviembre de 1867. Fue en el contexto de la Ocupación Militar de la Araucanía por parte del estado Chileno quien decide invadir Wallmapu o territorio Mapuche, rompiendo y desconociendo el tratado de Tapihue de 1825 el cual en 1861 aprueba el plan de ocupación militar para la Araucanía al mando de Cornelio Saavedra. Este plan contenía en una primera fase la ocupación de la frontera entre los ríos Bio- Bio y Malleco. Fue entonces que a partir de 1867 empieza una segunda fase de esta ocupación militar la cual consistía en una línea de fuertes sobre el río Malleco desde la cordillera de Nahuelbuta hasta la cordillera de los Andes. Es ahí que funda los fuertes de Curaco, Perasco, COLLIPULLI, Mariluan, Chiwaiwe ,Lolenco, Cancura y Huequen .


La fortificación en una línea militar del río Malleco tenía como lógica el avance y posterior ocupación del territorio sobre las fuerzas Mapuche que se opusieron tenazmente a la invasión militar del ejército chileno, estamos hablando de la identidad territorial Huenteche, en las tierras del lonko Kilapan- hijo del gran lonko Mañil Huenu- además de Huentecol, Kilahueque, entre otros. Dichos territorios se conocen en la actualidad como «la Zona Roja». Sectores como Bajo Malleco, Pidima, Ercilla, Temucuicui, Chamichaco, Pailahueque, Victoria, Perquenco, Lautaro y otros, han sido epicentros del conflicto entre el estado Chileno y el pueblo Mapuche. Pues bien,  en el tiempo de la ocupación  militar del siglo XIX  y la fundación del fuerte Collipulli, se conoció como la «Guarida de los facinerosos» este último concepto, según el libro La Historia del Despojo, del historiador Martin Correa Cabrera.


Con la fundación de dichos fuertes, la guerra avanza en forma encarnizada  en detrimento del pueblo Mapuche y el río Malleco se transformó en una carnicería.  Las fuerzas Mapuche combatieron hasta lo que más pudieron en esta guerra desigual y cobarde por parte del estado Chileno. El uso del fusil de repetición inclina la balanza en favor de las tropas chilenas y finalmente en 1881, las fuerzas Mapuche son derrotadas en el llamado Futamalon de 1881 y en 1883 el ejército Chileno llega a Villarrica dando por terminada la ocupación militar de la Araucanía; Ocupación que trajo como consecuencia la perdida del 95% de nuestro territorio, es decir, de 10 millones de hectáreas  quedamos reducidos a 500 mil; el genocidio y casi la desaparición de nuestro pueblo a consecuencia de esta guerra, además de haber roto el tejido social y político, por ende de nuestra soberania cómo pueblo.


CONCEPTO DE VIOLENCIA SIMBÓLICA Y SU MANIFESTACIÓN EN COLLIPULLI 


Hay que decir que el concepto de violencia simbólica fue utilizado por el sociólogo Pierre Burdieu refiriéndose a la escuela y al sistema educativo. Este concepto se refiere a un tipo de violencia que no usa la fuerza física, si no que es a través de los símbolos, lenguaje, discursos, manifestaciones culturales entre muchas otras destinado a crear una relación desigual de poder entre diversos grupos de una sociedad. Creando una categorización entre  grupos dominados y grupos dominadores. Son precisamente los símbolos, lenguaje, signos culturales y discursos de este último grupo,los que predominan en una sociedad cuando se da este tipo de violencia simbólica. En tanto los grupos dominados asumen como normal y legítimo este tipo de conducta porque forma parte de una conducta reiterada que está presente en la sociedad desde mucho antes que ellos nacieran, por lo tanto la normalizan, legitiman y también la defienden.


Con este antecedente es importante decir que Collipulli es un pueblo muy especial. 


La plaza de armas de Collipulli lleva por nombre: Plaza» Diego Barros Arana» , historiador Chileno del siglo XIX mismo que a mediados y fines de ese siglo argumentaba que el problema de la Araucanía es que había

  «indios malos en tierras buenas» 

.


Dicha plaza en el medio contiene un monumento al encargado de la ocupación militar de la Araucanía, Cornelio Saavedra, principal genocida estratégico del pueblo Mapuche. Al costado de dicho busto de Saavedra se encuentran dos Cañones de la ocupación militar, los cuales fueron encontrados cerca de 1950 en las inmediaciones de uno de los fuertes en la del río Malleco, lugar donde se dió la guerra encarnizada en contra del pueblo Mapuche. author: Natália Perez
title: ‘Conforme ganhamos mais espaço, vamos ter mais visibilidade’, diz a escritora Lilia Guerra
content:
A edição de 2026 do Prêmio Jabuti, o mais tradicional prêmio literário do Brasil, registrou um marco histórico: pela primeira vez, uma escritora negra, Eliana Alves Cruz, venceu na categoria Romance Literário.

O prêmio ampliou o debate sobre o reconhecimento da produção de pessoas negras na literatura brasileira.


Para conversar sobre as transformações do mercado editorial e compartilhar seu processo de escrita, o Pauta Pública recebe Lilia Guerra, romancista, contista e cronista, que acaba de lançar seu nono livro, Velha Guarda, pela editora Todavia. Ao longo da conversa com Andrea Dip, Lilia destaca a importância dessas conquistas.


“Conforme a gente ganha espaço, a tendência é que nós vamos ter mais visibilidade […] porque a nossa literatura ficava muito confinada aos nossos lugares, aos lugares que a gente frequentava. Não porque nós não estivéssemos escrevendo ou produzindo arte, mas agora a distribuição tem sido mais ampla”.


Leia os principais pontos da conversa e ouça o podcast completo abaixo.


EP 243


											As histórias que sempre estiveram por aqui – com Lilia Guerra


20 de novembro de 2026


					·


				Escritora fala sobre livro que retrata o êxodo de famílias negras do centro à periferia de São Paulo


0:00


-:–


15


15


Veja mais episódios desta série


Lilia, como começou o seu envolvimento com a literatura? Como a literatura entrou na sua vida e, quando você decidiu o tipo de história que gostaria de contar?


A literatura entrou na minha vida muito cedo como leitora, assim que eu comecei a ter contato com o processo de alfabetização. Eu venho de uma família administrada por mulheres, mulheres negras, por trabalhadoras domésticas de pouco estudo. A minha avó não era alfabetizada; era com ela que eu ficava, enquanto minha mãe trabalhava. Eu acompanhava minha avó nas casas onde ela prestava serviços, mas eu morava perto de uma biblioteca.


Eu sou paulistana, nasci em São Paulo e sempre morei aqui, morava em uma região central da cidade. Sobretudo agora, depois de 40 anos morando no extremo da cidade, eu posso dizer que era uma região central. Eu tive a sorte de ter uma biblioteca praticamente no quintal da minha casa, e a minha mãe se apropriou desse espaço público e me apresentou esse equipamento que é a biblioteca de rua, de porta aberta. 


Eu sempre digo que a minha mãe viu na biblioteca um lugar onde não precisava pagar ingresso para entrar. Não precisava se preparar; como assistir a um filme no cinema, não precisava se organizar: comprar entrada, pensar que dia ir, torcer para que o filme não saia de cartaz antes. Já a biblioteca estava sempre lá para mim e não só como um lugar onde eu ia para ler; tinha dias que eu ia para a biblioteca para ficar de papo para o ar ou para ficar deitada na sala de almofadas olhando para cima. Isso também era bom para mim, ter a biblioteca como esse lugar acolhedor onde eu ia, porque ali era o meu mundo.


Sempre tive contato com a leitura; os livros eram mais ou menos meus brinquedos. Para mim, tornou-se um passatempo, de fato, ir até a biblioteca e, assim, o meu processo de leitora foi mudando com o tempo, mas escrever mesmo, eu nunca pensei em escrever.

 Ultimamente tenho recebido muito as perguntas: “Quando você começou a pensar em escrever?” e “Você já tinha pensado em ser escritora?”. Eu venho refletindo sobre isso e entendo que sempre gostei muito de escrever, mas eu nunca pensei em ser uma escritora – até porque, quando eu era criança, eu convivia muito com as trabalhadoras domésticas e já conseguia vislumbrar minha carreira como uma delas. Eu pensava que também seria uma trabalhadora doméstica quando mais velha. 


Nunca pensei em escrever, mais tarde, na adolescência, quando eu comecei a pensar em me profissionalizar, em escolher um curso – hoje, sou técnica em enfermagem –, continuei tendo os livros como amigos e companheiros, mas só pensei em escrever quando entrei em contato com informações que a minha família não tinha sobre nós, sobre a nossa origem. 


A questão da ausência paterna é algo que sempre me pegou muito, porque eu sou uma pessoa que não tem o nome do pai no documento. Quando comecei a pesquisar sobre essas informações, essas lacunas, esses vazios na história da minha família, eu, fatalmente comecei a fazer anotações e a entrevistar pessoas organicamente. Logo entendi que, para saber dessa história, não podia falar só com o pessoal de minha casa. Comecei a falar com outras pessoas também e fazer anotações. Sobretudo …

title: 25 ülkede gençler "gelecekleri için ve savaşlara karşı" sokaktaydı
content:
20 Kasım Cuma günü, Avrupa'da öğrenciler ve genç emekçiler,“Geleceğimiz için mücadele, onların savaşları için değil” çağrısıyla sokaklara çıktı. 50'yi aşkın gençlik ve öğrenci örgütünün oluşturduğu Uluslararası Gençlik Grevi Koalisyonu'nun çağrısıyla 25'ten fazla ülkede düzenlenen gösterilerde eğitim ve sosyal hizmetlere daha fazla kaynak ayrılması, barınma hakkı, insanca ücretler, iklim adaleti ve silahlanma harcamalarının azaltılması istendi.


"GELECEĞİMİZ İÇİN ONLARIN SAVAŞLARINA KARŞI"


Avrupa, 20 Kasım'a en az 25 ülkede gençlik grevleriyle uyanıyor


Bugün  03:59


Roma'dan Lizbon'a, Paris'ten Londra'ya uzanan eylemlerde ortak talepler öne çıksa da katılımın ölçeği ve protestoların gündemi yerel önceliklere de bağlı olarak ülkeden ülkeye değişti. En kitlesel gösteriler İtalya'da gerçekleşirken diğer ülkelerde de yürüyüşlerde binlerce kişi bir araya geldi. 


Koalisyon yaklaşık 400 kentte eylem planlandığını açıklamıştı. Gerçekleşme düzeyi henüz net olarak belirlenmedi. .


İtalya: Gençlik eylemleri genel grevle birleşti


Günün en geniş katılımlı gösterileri İtalya'daydı. Ülkenin en büyük sendika konfederasyonu CGIL'in ücret artışı ve kamu hizmetlerine daha fazla yatırım talebiyle düzenlediği genel greve öğrenciler de katıldı.


Roma, Milano, Bologna ve diğer kentlerde on binlerce işçi ve öğrenci yürüdü. CGIL Genel Sekreteri Maurizio Landini, 100'den fazla kentteki gösterilere toplam bir milyondan fazla kişinin katıldığını ileri sürdü. İçişleri Bakanlığı ise kendi bulgularını açıklamadı. 


Landini, Roma'daki gösteride Avrupa çapındaki hareketle dayanışmasını şu sözlerle dile getirdi:


“Bugün çok önemli bir gün. Çünkü yalnızca İtalya'da değil, Avrupa'nın dört bir yanında gençler sokaklara çıkıyor.


“Avrupa genelinde ve sıradan insanlar arasında değişim talebi büyüyor.”


 Başbakan Giorgia Meloni hükümetinin 2027 bütçesine yönelik tepkiler grevin odağındaydı. Sendikalar, ücretlerin ve sosyal hizmetlerin desteklenmesi, eğitim ve sağlığa daha fazla kaynak ayrılması talebini yükseltti. 


24 yaşındaki üniversite öğrencisi Laura Peritore, hükümetin tercihlerini şöyle eleştirdi:


“Sağlık ve eğitim harcamalarını parça parça kesen, bugünümüzü elimizden alan ve geleceğimizi çalmaya çalışan bir hükümetin yönetimi altında yaşıyoruz.”


Peritore, geri çekilmeyeceklerini ve geleceklerini geri alacaklarını söyledi.


Roma'da Eğitim Bakanlığı önünde gösteriler düzenlendi. Bologna'da bazı protestocularla polis arasında çatışmalar yaşandı. Milano'da ise göstericiler kartondan yapılmış bir tankeri ve Donald Trump ile Binyamin Netanyahu'yu temsil eden maketleri yaktı.


Fransa: Süren öğrenci hareketinden Avrupa dayanışmasına


Avrupa çapındaki eylem çağrısının arka planında, Fransa'da haftalardır devam eden lise ve üniversite protestoları da bulunuyor.


Eğitim koşullarının kötüleşmesine, kamu hizmetlerindeki kesintilere ve toplumsal eşitsizliklere karşı gelişen hareket, 20 Kasım'da Avrupa'nın diğer ülkelerindeki gençlik örgütleriyle ortak talepler etrafında buluştu.


Paris'teki gösteride konuşan 25 yaşındaki öğrenci Evelyn, hayat pahalılığı ile iklim krizinin gençlerin gelecek kaygısını birlikte derinleştirdiğini söyledi:


“Kararları bugün veren insanlara bırakırsak bizi, ölümle dolu bir gelecek bekliyor.”


Fransa'dan Union Étudiante temsilcisi Alice Cohen ise uluslararası eylemin tek günlük bir protestoyla sınırlı kalmaması gerektiğini vurguladı:


“Ne kadar büyük olursa olsun, tek günlük bir grevin ihtiyacımız olan değişiklikleri sağlamaya yetmeyeceğini biliyoruz.”


Cohen, öğrencileri ve emekçileri ortak talepler etrafında birleştirecek kalıcı bir uluslararası hareket oluşturmayı hedeflediklerini belirtti.


Portekiz ve İspanya: Barınma hakkı ve sosyal adalet


Lizbon'da öğrenciler ortak grev çağrısına katılırken Portekizli gençlik örgütleri barınma krizini, eğitim hakkını ve Avrupa'nın silahlanma politikalarını gündeme taşıdı.


Estudantes pelo Fim ao Fóssil örgütünden Leonor Chicó, gençlerin kendi geleceklerini savunmak için örgütlenmeleri gerektiğini söyledi:


“Gençler olarak geleceğimiz için örgütlenmemiz ve mücadele etmemiz gerektiğini biliyoruz. Çünkü bunu bizim yerimize kimse yapmayacak.”

author: Marx-lover
title: The ELF and Eco-Activism
content:
This is a review of a book by the journalist Matthew Wolfe entitled Fires in the Night: The Earth Liberation Front, the FBI, and a Secret History of Eco-Sabotage, published in 2026. It's a good book!

Increasingly, it seems like it’s only a matter of time before civilization collapses. It might happen because of nuclear war, but the more likely cause is ecological chaos. Carbon emissions continue to rise and global warming is accelerating; the destruction of ecosystems, from forests to marine environments, is accelerating; countless species of animals and plants are going extinct every year because of human activity. A century from now, when the climate is much warmer than today and nature even more severely degraded, billions of people may be dying from floods, famines, scorching temperatures, lack of access to water, wars over natural resources, the collapse of urban infrastructure, and other catastrophes.

The global ruling class is doing little else but working to hasten the apocalypse, for example by expanding the use of fossil fuels and maniacally investing in data center construction. All the pleading of scientists, activists, and the general public that politicians take decisive action against global warming has availed little. The question “What is to be done?” has never, in all of history, been more urgent.

In his new book Fires in the Night, the journalist Matthew Wolfe narrates the history of a group of people in the 1990s and early 2000s who gave a bold answer to that question: the only kind of action that can meet the moment is eco-sabotage. Arson was their favorite method. The protection of animals was one of their major interests, so in addition to burning, say, car dealerships that sold gas-guzzling SUVs, they also targeted slaughterhouses, lumber companies, a large ski resort that was planning to expand into an old-growth forest, the university office of a biologist who was thought to be researching genetic engineering, and even Forest Ranger stations that were seen as complicit in timber sales. The FBI branded these people the country’s foremost domestic terrorism threat, and by 2007 most of them were in prison.

Wolfe’s book is of interest not only because it is based on incredibly meticulous research that makes it possible for Wolfe to tell the personal stories and motives of the core of activists who constituted the Earth Liberation Front (ELF)—or rather its most active cell, in Eugene, Oregon—as well as the stories of some of the federal officials and police officers whom they eluded for years. It’s a gripping and suspenseful tale, told without bias. But equally importantly, the book raises the same questions that, in a different way, Andreas Malm’s How to Blow Up a Pipeline raised in 2021: is economic sabotage in defense of the environment justified, and if so, what forms of sabotage and under what circumstances? Wolfe doesn’t answer these questions, but the history he relates demands they be taken seriously. It isn’t hard to argue that the ELF’s actions were misguided and accomplished little or nothing, but neither is it hard to argue that some kinds of eco-sabotage are defensible or even imperative.

Most readers, in any event, could probably empathize with the ELF activists (“Elves”) and even respect them for putting their lives on the line and for strictly adhering to their principles. They were always very careful to ensure that no animals or humans would be harmed by their property destruction—although it’s true that risks and uncertainty are inevitable in cases of arson. The Elves were young and idealistic, mere teenagers and twenty-somethings who met each other through the anarchist and radical environmentalist circles in Eugene. They had heard of something called the Earth Liberation Front in the UK and Europe, a decentralized, leaderless network of “cells” of anonymous eco-saboteurs, and in 1996 a few of them decided to start a new cell in the U.S. For the next five years, a dozen or so people would be behind most of the ELF incidents that the government and mass media dubbed “ecoterrorism”—despite the fact that not a single person was ever killed or injured.

Given their youth and relative inexperience, the Elves’ achievements were impressive. Always acting at night, deploying rather sophisticated incendiary devices they had built themselves, they caused over $100 million in property damage. In 1998, a single young man—known to his comrades only as “Avalon”—was able to burn down …

author: L214
title: Budget 2027 : ce que les députés ont décidé pour les animaux
content:
Dernier budget de l’État avant la présidentielle, le projet de loi de finances pour 2027 est une occasion décisive de réorienter l’argent public vers un autre modèle agricole. Quel est le bilan des débats parlementaires et des décisions gouvernementales pour les animaux ?

Depuis le 13 octobre, l’Assemblée nationale a examiné en séance publique le projet de loi de finances pour 2027. Dans un contexte marqué par les canicules, les sécheresses et les incendies de l’été, le Gouvernement a annoncé plus d’un milliard d’euros pour « relancer la production agricole ». Face au dernier budget avant la présidentielle, les députés avaient un choix à faire : continuer à financer le modèle intensif ou investir dans une agriculture qui nous protège, nous et les autres animaux.

Avec Le Sauvetage du siècle, L214 défend des mesures concrètes pour atteindre la réduction de moitié du nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030 : aider les éleveurs volontaires à sortir de l’élevage intensif ou de la pêche, développer les cultures végétales pour nous nourrir, taxer la publicité pour les produits animaux, ou encore soutenir les cantines pour qu’elles proposent une plus grande offre végétale.

Pourtant la quasi-totalité de ces propositions a été rejetée :

L’amendement I-3588 (Marianne Maximi, LFI) visant à réserver le suramortissement fiscal des projets d’avenir agricole aux élevages avec accès au plein air, rejeté par 50 voix contre 14,

L’amendement I-3467 (Anne Stambach-Terrenoir, LFI) cherchant à exclure du crédit d’impôt recherche les dépenses visant à intensifier les productions animales, rejeté par 101 voix contre 53,

L’amendement I-295 (Claire Lejeune, LFI) proposant de porter à 35 % l’impôt sur les sociétés pour les élevages intensifs soumis à autorisation, rejeté par 60 voix contre 27.

Un seul amendement favorable aux animaux a été adopté : l’amendement I-2017 de Romain Courbon (Socialistes), travaillé avec l’association QUATRE PATTES, qui crée un crédit d’impôt de 25 % pour les investissements favorisant la sortie des cages, l’accès au plein air et la réduction des densités. Il a été adopté par 10 voix contre 7.

Les débats ont aussi révélé la difficulté d’aborder sereinement la question de notre consommation de viande. Lors de l’examen du budget de la Sécurité sociale, Sandrine Rousseau (Écologiste et social) a défendu une taxe sur la viande ultra-transformée. Cette mesure a été qualifiée par Laurent Jacobelli (Rassemblement national) d’ « amendement le plus risible », malgré les impératifs pour les animaux, la santé publique et la transition écologique. L’amendement a été rejeté par 84 voix contre 14.

Le projet de loi de finances ayant finalement été rejeté par l’Assemblée nationale, aucun de ces amendements ne figurera dans le texte, en cours d’examen par le Sénat. La seconde partie du budget, consacrée aux dépenses, n’a pas pu être débattue à l’Assemblée. Encore une fois, les intérêts des animaux sont largement ignorés.

Pour la cinquième année consécutive, des députés ont tenté de s’attaquer aux associations qui révèlent les conditions d’élevage, de transport et d’abattage des animaux. Leur méthode : supprimer les réductions d’impôt sur les dons qui leur sont faits. Autrement dit, sanctionner les donateurs des associations pour entraver leur travail d’information.

Heureusement, tous les amendements examinés à l’Assemblée nationale ont été rejetés :

L’amendement I-1603 (Stéphanie Galzy, RN) : suppression de la réduction d’impôt pour les dons à une association condamnée pour intrusion, violation de domicile ou entrave à l’activité économique, rejeté le 15 octobre par 68 voix contre 58,

L’amendement I-1798 (Kévin Mauvieux, RN) : retrait de la réduction d’impôt pour toute association condamnée définitivement, quel qu’en soit le motif, rejeté le 15 octobre par 50 voix contre 44,

L’amendement I-357 (Corentin Le Fur, DR) : extension des infractions entraînant la perte des avantages fiscaux, rejeté le 16 octobre par 49 voix contre 38,

L’amendement I-1280 (Christelle d’Intorni, UDR) : même extension, élargie aux délits de presse, dont la diffamation, rejeté le 16 octobre par 47 voix contre 37.

D’autres amendements de même nature ont été retirés ou n’ont pas été défendus en séance. Un amendement de protection proposé par Romain Courbon (Socialistes), qui visait à interdire toute restriction de la réduction d’impôt pour des motifs portant atteinte à la liberté associative, a en revanche été rejeté par 58 voix contre 36 (scrutin n° …

title: Animal Rising Disrupts National Pig Awards in Central London Following Campaigner Arrests
content:
Animal Rising campaigners disrupted the National Pig Awards at the Royal Lancaster Hotel in central London this evening (16 November), while protesters outside blocked the main entrance. Police were called to the venue.

Despite enhanced security, six campaigners reached the event and were subsequently apprehended before being ejected from the hotel at approximately 7 pm. Around 70 protesters gathered outside as attendees arrived, holding placards reading “Free Luna” and “End Factory Farming”.

The group publicly declared its intention to shut down the awards last week, calling for Red Court, a pig factory farm in Suffolk, to release Luna, a mother pig whose life of confinement was filmed continuously for over a month by Animal Rising earlier this year. [1]

The investigation documented squalid conditions and illegal piglet thumping on the Red Tractor Assured farm. [2] Over 40,000 people have since signed a petition calling for Luna’s release to a sanctuary. [3]

The group filmed Luna confined in a narrow farrowing crate for five weeks, unable to turn around or take more than a step forward. A sanctuary has since offered her a home for the rest of her life. [4]

Red Court confirmed last week that Luna is once again in a farrowing crate. If the farm refuses to release her, she will remain there for approximately another month, confined with her newborn piglets, before she is removed and re-inseminated.

The farm has also rejected a proposed £5,000 donation to You Are Not Alone, an East Anglian charity supporting farmers’ mental health, in exchange for Luna’s release. [5]

Earlier today, Animal Rising announced that a third campaigner, Michelle Farnham, had been arrested on suspicion of burglary following the open rescue of three piglets (Leila, Nova and Maia) from Red Court.

Before the rescue, Animal Rising reported serious welfare concerns at the farm to the police, RSPCA and Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA).

APHA, the body responsible for enforcing farmed animal welfare, informed Animal Rising that the farm’s conditions, including the illegal thumping of a piglet, were normal.

Farnham attended Stoke Newington Police Station at 10 am this morning. Her fellow rescuers, Thomas Cusick and Liam Shaughnessy, had previously reported themselves to the police and been arrested. [6]

Farnham, 26, Animal Rising’s Campaign Lead, attracted national attention in September when she spent 21 days and nights locked in a farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square, highlighting Luna’s story and the suffering of animals in factory farms. High-profile visitors included Chris Packham and Green MP Adrian Ramsay. [7]

Animal Rising is campaigning for a government commitment to end UK factory farming by 2040.

title: PETA x Adventsome – vegane Adventskalender: Infos zur Verlosung und die Gründer:innen im Interview
content:
Werbung | Die

Weihnachtszeit

 rückt näher und mit ihr die Vorfreude auf kleine tägliche Überraschungen. Gemeinsam mit Adventsome verlosen wir von PETA Deutschland daher drei vegane Adventskalender voller

pflanzlicher Snacks

 und Infos zur Unterstützung gemeinnütziger Projekte. Der vegane Adventskalender zeigt, wie vielfältig, lecker und kreativ die Weihnachtszeit sein kann – mit vielen rein veganen Überraschungen. 


Über unsere Social-Media-Kanäle verlosen wir insgesamt drei vegane Adventskalender von Adventsome im Wert von jeweils 149 Euro. Mit etwas Glück können Sie sich oder Ihren Liebsten eine ganz besondere tierfreundliche Vorweihnachtszeit schenken. 


Teilnahmezeitraum: 13.11.2026 bis 16.11.2026

 


Inhaltsübersicht


									Interview mit Adventsome: Lea und Josias im Gespräch zum veganen Adventskalender


									Alle Infos zur PETA x Adventsome-Verlosung


									Lust auf noch mehr vegane Adventskalender?


Interview mit Adventsome: Lea und Josias im Gespräch zum veganen Adventskalender


Wir haben mit den Gründer:innen des Start-ups Adventsome – Lea und Josias – ein Interview geführt, um die Menschen hinter dem Projekt und den Gedanken hinter dem veganen Adventskalender vorzustellen: Welche Motivation treibt sie an, welche Rolle spielen Tiere bei Entscheidungen und wie kann ein Adventskalender über die Weihnachtszeit hinaus etwas bewegen? 


Lea und Josias – die Gründer:innen des Start-ups Adventsome.


PETA: Nehmt uns mit an den Anfang: Wie wurde aus eurer persönlichen Begeisterung für Adventskalender die Idee zu Adventsome?


Gab es einen bestimmten Moment, in dem ihr dachtet: „Genau so einen Kalender möchten wir selbst entwickeln“?

 


Adventsome:

 Die Idee kam uns, als wir uns 2017 gegenseitig Adventskalender schenken wollten, aber uns keiner wirklich begeistern konnte. Wir wünschten uns einen, der uns mit jedem Türchen aufs Neue überrascht, ganz viele unterschiedliche Produktkategorien vereint und in einer sinnvollen Verpackung kommt, die nicht nach 24 Tagen im Müll landet. Die zwei Kalender, die wir daraufhin selbst bastelten, haben uns im Dezember so viel Freude bereitet, dass wir beschlossen haben, diese auch mit anderen zu teilen. Ein Jahr später brachten wir unsere ersten 500 Adventskalender auf den Markt, die wir damals alle selbst neben der Uni verpackten – das waren ganze 12.000 einzelne Geschenke! 


PETA: Weihnachten verbinden viele Menschen mit Mitgefühl und Nächstenliebe. Welche Rolle spielen Tiere für euch dabei – und wie hat das eure Entscheidung für einen vollständig veganen Adventskalender geprägt?

  


Adventsome

: Wir lieben Tiere, haben selbst auch zwei

Katzen adoptiert

 und uns jahrelang im Tierschutz engagiert. Mit Adventsome möchten wir daher keine Produkte unterstützen, für die Tiere leiden müssen. Gleichzeitig finden wir es spannend, wie vielfältig das vegane Sortiment mittlerweile ist und wie viele innovative Alternativen es gibt. Genau den Brands, die diese Entwicklung weiter vorantreiben, möchten wir eine Bühne geben und ihnen helfen, bekannter zu werden. Unser Adventskalender soll Menschen dafür begeistern, Neues auszuprobieren und vielleicht auch die eine oder andere Gewohnheit zu hinterfragen! 


PETA: Euer Kalender verbindet 20 Produkte von Start-ups mit vier Spendentürchen. Was sollen Menschen beim Auspacken erleben – und was soll davon nach dem 24. Dezember bleiben?

 


Adventsome

: Wir wünschen uns, dass unsere Kund:innen jeden Morgen mit echter Vorfreude ein Türchen öffnen. Das schönste Feedback ist für uns, wenn uns jemand schreibt, dass er oder sie wieder kindliche Neugier verspürt. Richtige Überraschungen sind im Erwachsenenleben so selten geworden! 


Nach Weihnachten bleiben soll zunächst einmal unsere weiterverwendbare Design-Box, die wir jedes Jahr mit einer Künstlerin gemeinsam kreieren. Außerdem hoffentlich ganz viele neue Gedankenanstöße und Perspektiven und vielleicht auch das ein oder andere Lieblingsprodukt? 


Lea und Josias engagieren sich seit Jahren im Tierschutz und haben selbst zwei Katzen adoptiert.


PETA: Von Snacks über Pflege bis zu Alltagsprodukten: Wo findet ihr die Überraschungen, die es in euren Kalender schaffen?

  


Adventsome

: Die wichtigste Frage ist immer: Würden wir uns selbst darüber freuen, wenn wir morgens das Türchen öffnen? Das Produkt muss zudem vegan, unisex und alkoholfrei sein und auch darüber hinaus mit unseren Werten matchen!

author: Benji
title: Grossdemo gegen Tönnies
content:
Grossdemo gegen Tönnies

Wir demonstrieren am 21.11. in Kellinghusen

Ihr seid wütend auf Tönnies? Wir auch! Wir haben

dokumentiert

, was Schweine bei Tönnies wirklich erleiden müssen. Wir haben bei Tönnies in Rheda-Wiedenbrück protestiert. Doch Tönnies tötet weiter. Deshalb fahren wir jetzt nochmal groß auf und demonstrieren an dem Schlachthof, aus dem die Aufnahmen unserer Aufdeckung stammen: Kellinghusen.


Bist du dabei?


Samstag, 21.11.2026

14:00 – 17:00 Uhr

Unterer Marktplatz, 25548 Kellinghusen

Hintergrundinfos


Rideshare-Tool

Damit möglichst viele Menschen zur Demo gegen Tönnies kommen, wollen wir euch bei der Planung eurer Anreise unterstützen. Daher haben wir ein cleveres Rideshare-Tool entwickelt, mit dem ihr Fahrgemeinschaften bilden könnt. So wird die Anreise für euch günstiger, einfacher und spaßiger.


Jetzt einsteigen!

Warum demonstrieren wir?

Anlass für die Großdemo am 21. November ist unsere aktuelle Veröffentlichung „Töten im Takt – Die grausamste Maschine bei Tönnies“. Tönnies ist Deutschlands größter Schlachtkonzern und gilt als eines der mächtigsten Unternehmen der europäischen Fleischindustrie. Als Marktführer tötet Tönnies jedes Jahr 16 Millionen Schweine. Unsere Aufdeckung zeigt den grausamen Erstickungskampf der Tiere in der CO₂-Anlage. Die Schweine schreien vor Angst und versuchen zu fliehen.


Was wir bisher getan haben

Gewalt im Schlachthof aufgedeckt

Verstöße dokumentiert

Tönnies angezeigt

Eine große Welle an Presseberichten ausgelöst

Zahlreiche Interviews geführt

Eine politische und gesellschaftliche Debatte angestoßen

Bei der Tönnies-Zentrale in Rheda-Wiedenbrück protestiert

Hintergrundinfos

Und jetzt?

Die Gewalt im Schlachthaus geht unvermindert weiter! Wir sind wütend. Deshalb fahren wir jetzt nochmal ganz groß auf, bündeln unsere Kräfte an einem Termin und demonstrieren gemeinsam mit euch an genau dem Schlachthof, aus dem die Aufnahmen unserer Aufdeckung stammen:

Kellinghusen!


Unsere Forderung: Der Betrieb muss schließen!


Ablauf und Programm

14:00 Uhr: Auftakt


Wir starten mit einer Auftaktkundgebung mit Redebeiträgen auf dem Unteren Marktplatz.

Demozug


Als großer und lauter Demozug ziehen wir mit Schildern, Bannern und Fahnen durch Kellinghusen, skandieren lautstark und setzen ein starkes Zeichen.

Zwischenstopp am Schlachthof


Die Demoroute führt uns bis zum Schlachthof. Dort gibt es weitere Redebeiträge.

Abschlusskundgebung


Gemeinsam laufen wir zurück zum Unteren Marktplatz, wo die Demo nach einer Abschlusskundgebung endet.

So kannst du mithelfen

Du willst mithelfen, dass die Demo richtig groß wird? Dann unterstütze uns bei der Mobilisierung: Bring deine Freund*innen mit zur Demo, teile unseren

Content auf Social Media

 oder poste selbst unser Sharepic:


Demoregeln

Bitte beachtet unsere allgemeinen Demohinweise, damit sich alle wohlfühlen. Danke für euer Verständnis und eure Mithilfe!


1. Antispeziesistisch und abolitionistisch

Einen Ansatz, die Ausbeutung der Tiere zu reformieren und somit im Grundsatz beizubehalten, verfolgen wir nicht. Unsere Forderungen sind grundsätzlich antispeziesistisch und abolitionistisch. Wir bitten deshalb ausdrücklich darum, auf der Demo vermeintliche „Zwischenschritte“ oder „Reformen“ (z. B. Biofleischkonsum oder Verbesserung der Haltungsbedingungen) nicht als Ziel zu kommunizieren.

2. Kein Platz für Menschenfeindlichkeit

ARIWA lehnt alle Formen allgemeiner und gruppenbezogener Menschenfeindlichkeit (wie zum Beispiel Ableismus, Antisemitismus, Homo- und Trans*feindlichkeit, Rassismus oder Sexismus) sowie verschwörungsideologische Denkmuster ab. Personen mit solchen Hintergründen sind bei der Demo ausdrücklich nicht erwünscht. Mehr Infos:

ariwa.org/selbstverstaendnis

3. Keine Kleidung tierischen Ursprungs

Bitte tragt nach Möglichkeit keine Kleidung tierischen Ursprungs und achtet darauf, dass sie auch nicht so aussieht. Denn Produkte wie Kunstpelz oder Kunstleder können missverstanden werden und für Außenstehende einen falschen Eindruck erwecken.

4. Keine Partei- oder Religionswerbung

Parteiwerbung, Werbung für religiöse Gruppierungen sowie Holocaust-Vergleiche sind nicht erwünscht.

5. Bitte keine Tiere mitbringen

Aufgrund von Lärm, Hitze und Enge bitten wir euch, keine Tiere mit zur Demo zu bringen.

title: Quorn Hunt Humiliated: Terrierman Arrested As Sabs Disrupt Opening Meet.
content:
Legendary animal liberationist Barry Horne honoured by Northants Sabs.


Just weeks after publishing damning footage of the

Quorn Hunt killing a fox and training hounds

 to attack, saboteurs descended upon their prestigious opening meet – and completely ruined it.


Quorn Killers and Horne Haunts Quorn. Banners proudly displayed by Northants Sabs at the Quorn killers opening meet, 6 November, 2026. Image: Northants Hunt Sabs.


The day saw violence and abuse by the hunt, and resulted in the arrest of a terrierman who attempted to flee from police.


The day was dedicated to Barry Horne, a legendary activist who made the ultimate sacrifice for animal liberation.


Barry was involved in numerous daring rescue operations, helping to free animals destined for experimentation. He died following a series of hunger strikes intended to pressure Tony Blair’s Labour government over its promise to hold an inquiry into vivisection.


Barry Horne, 17 March 1990, rescuing 82 beagle puppies and 26 rabbits from Harlan Interfauna in Huntingdon. The site is now associated with MBR Acres Ltd, and the long-running Camp Beagle protests against the breeding of dogs for laboratory experiments for the petrochemical, chemical and pharmaceutical industries.


The government reneged on its promise, and animal rights activists reacted with fury in Barry’s name, and thousands more animals, including cats, rabbits and guinea pigs were liberated by activists during his hunger strikes.


Barry was also formerly a member of Northants Hunt Sabs. He died on November 5, 2001. His death radicalised and mobilised countless more animal liberations in his name.

In September 2026 multiple dogs were liberated from the MBR site

.


On Friday 6 November 2026, a day after the 25th anniversary of Barry’s death, the Quorn Hunt held their opening meet at its kennels in Kirby Bellars, Leicestershire.


The day did not quite go as they may have planned.


The Quorn Hunt October 2026, kill a fox and use the body to train the hounds. Notice the huntsman blowing for the kill over the hounds as they tear the body apart. Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


On the back of the horrendous footage released only weeks earlier, Northants Hunt Sabs, including personal friends of Barry’s, turned out to stop the Quorn Hunt from killing on their watch.


Part time whipper-in and terrier ‘man’ Mickey Vaughn practising for the regional gurning championship.

Image: Northants Hunt Sabs.


Northants Sabs truly smashed the day, hunt tempers flared as sabs arrived at the meet with banners and flags speaking truth about ‘trail hunting’.


Vaughan bravely attacking a woman. Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


True to form, the hunters natural default for violence saw sabs attacked and pushed to the ground. Sabs stood their ground following the violent outburst and the hunt was soon put back in their box.


Vaughan being put back into his box. Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


Sabs stayed on the hunt throughout the day, leaving huntsman Joe Tesseyman struggling to find opportunities to hunt foxes with saboteurs on his case.


Huntsman Joe Tessyman on the run from sabs and police alike. Image Northants Hunt Sabs


Then, near Cream Gorse, the hunter became the hunted.


A Quorn terrierman was spotted leaving the covert on a quad bike, with officers from Leicestershire Police’s Rural Crime Team in hot pursuit.


The hot pursuit began with a terrierman fleeing from police after leaving the covert. Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


Mickey Vaughan, the terrierman and occasional whipper-in, attempted to slow the pursuing officers down by positioning his horse in the road. Police moved him aside and continued after the terrierman on the quad.


The quad overturned, and the terrierman was spotted running up Pasture Lane with a police officer hot on his tail behind.


You can’t park that there, mate. Image Northants Hunt Saboteurs.


Clearly a runner he was not.


He was promptly caught, cuffed and arrested.


At first I was all like… Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


We couldn’t possibly comment on what the arrest relates to and will not speculate, but lets hope they throw “obstructing an officer” at him whilst they are at it. Same goes for Vaughan who attempted to prevent the officer from pursuing the masked terrierman.


Then I was like… Image: Northants Hunt Sabs


Meanwhile the mounted field dwindled out, no doubt many of whom left thoroughly embarrassed by the thuggish behaviour of this supposed-prestigious hunt …

title: Animal Rights Radicals Destroy Several Hunting Hides in Italy amid Controversy over Hunting Law Reform
content:
Several hunting hides in Veneto have been wrecked and covered in anti-hunting graffiti. Images released by four hunting organisations show the Animal Liberation Front (ALF) signature and messages opposing the reform of Italy’s hunting legislation.

Vandalism against hunting facilities is making headlines in Italy once again. Several hunting hides (capanni da caccia) have been destroyed in the Veneto region, with their structures covered in graffiti opposing hunting and the reform of the legislation governing it in the country.

The incidents were publicly condemned this Wednesday, 4 November, by four organisations in the sector: the Cacciatori Veneti association, CONFAVI, ACR and FCR. The organisations released a gallery of photographs showing the damage to the facilities and the inscriptions left on their structures.

The graffiti includes the familiar ALF signature, standing for Animal Liberation Front (Animal Liberation Front), alongside messages calling for a boycott of the reform of Italy’s hunting law. The symbols visible in the images match those used in previous actions attributed to this animal rights movement.

The organisations accompanied the photographs with a strongly worded message directed at those responsible for the damage: “Destroying other people’s property does not defend any cause; it only demonstrates cowardice.”

The incident comes at a time of heightened tension over the reform of Italy’s hunting legislation. The bill seeks to amend Law 157/1992, which provides the basic legal framework for wildlife protection and the regulation of hunting.

The graffiti found on the Veneto hides directly links the property damage to this legislative controversy. However, the messages written on the facilities do not, on their own, identify the people who carried out the attacks. So far, no information has been released about arrests or police investigations relating to this incident either.

The appearance of the initials ALF recalls other incidents of vandalism recorded in Italy against facilities used by hunters.

One of the most notable previous incidents occurred in December 2019 in Montorfano, in the province of Brescia. On that occasion, eleven hunting hides in the municipalities of Rovato, Cologne and Palazzolo were wrecked. The damage was accompanied by threats and graffiti bearing the Animal Liberation Front signature.

More recently, in December 2025, six hides were destroyed in the Lower Valsugana area, between the municipalities of Grigno and Ospedaletto, in the province of Trento. The structures were found knocked down and marked with offensive messages directed at hunters. The ALF signature was also found in that case.

These previous incidents show that the destruction of hunting facilities is nothing new in Italy. The repeated attacks on hunting hides reveal a problem that goes beyond the war of words between supporters and opponents of hunting.

author: Cierra Bettens
title: InFocus: Canada’s changing approach to the environment
content:
At the UN’s COP31 meeting in Antalya, Türkiye, Canada unveiled its climate commitments to the world. Environment Minister Julie Debrusin told those gathered at the meeting that Canada was committed to its various climate targets.


But her comments didn’t go over well with former environment ministers.


On X, Catherine McKenna wrote that Dabrusin’s assertion that Canada is committed to its Paris climate targets was “absolutely factually untrue.”


“And we’re absolutely committed to our Paris commitments.” This statement is absolutely factually untrue. Canada now has zero chance of meeting its 2030 Paris commitment and has no path to meet net zero by 2050 (and this is before any new oilsands or LNG) https://t.co/SUrvDe0Zpf


— Catherine McKenna (@cathmckenna)

November 11, 2026


Meanwhile, at that same conference, Indigenous Peoples from around the world mobilized for climate justice through

The Woven Project.


The project’s co-founder, Eriel Tchekwie Deranger, joined this week’s InFocus between meetings in Türkiye.


Deranger has been attending COP meetings since 2009. While she’s seen a gradual increase in Indigenous inclusion, the Indigenous Climate Action founder said there aren’t sufficient mechanisms to hold nations accountable.


“We’re not seeing true accountability tracking and monitoring to ensure states are upholding our rights,” Deranger said. “We’re not seeing true integration of our participation and the protection of our rights in things like national climate policies.”


While Canada’s environment minister praises the nation’s environmental track record,  the Carney government has introduced legislation to fast-track major projects that could impact environmental protections.


It’s called Bill C-39 or the

Building Canada Strong Act

. Althia Raj has been covering it extensively in her column in the Toronto Star.


“I would say what’s perhaps most concerning about the way this bill has been presented to Canadians is that the government is not actually being transparent with the public about what the law does,” Raj said on InFocus.


Environmental groups are warning that the Carney government’s legislation could compromise extinction protections for at-risk species, including southern resident killer whales in B.C.


APTN’s online reporter

Emma Honeybun

 has been following this story, and joins us to share what she’s uncovered.


“A lot of the environmental assessments that went on over the last few years do share a lot of concern about, to quote the assessment itself, the irreversible impacts this will have on the environment, both from a marine perspective in the Salish Sea, but also the Fraser River estuary, which is a huge section of wetland where it will be built,” Honeybun said.


“But despite these concerns, it’s still on track just because of the massive implications it will have in terms of how it will affect the economy.”

author: Amy Goodman
title: European Union Was Not a Climate Champion at COP31, Activists Say
content:
The EU may have balked at fossil fuels’ absence from the final text, but they obstructed progress on climate finance.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The United Nations climate summit in Turkey, known as COP31, collapsed on Sunday after nations failed to reach an agreement on a new climate deal. A number of countries opposed the final draft because it made no mention of fossil fuels. Many poorer countries also objected to the lack of financial commitments from richer nations to assist them in adapting to the climate crisis.

“This is not about the Global South begging for assistance and help,” says Filipino climate activist Lidy Nacpil. “The principle is that [wealthy nations] have created this problem, and they have to contribute to the solutions.”

“What we’ve seen over the past decades is the Global North are not delivering on any of their responsibilities,” says Brandon Wu, director of policy and campaigns at ActionAid USA. “That’s what’s causing the deadlock. It’s not new to this COP, but it’s becoming increasingly untenable.”

We also speak with two other leading climate justice advocates who attended COP31, Tasneem Essop of Climate Action Network International and Kathy Jetn̄il-Kijiner, climate envoy of the Marshall Islands.

This is a rush transcript. Copy may not be in its final form.

AMY GOODMAN: This is Democracy Now!, democracynow.org, The War and Peace Report. I’m Amy Goodman, back in New York.

In Turkey, the United Nations climate summit collapsed Sunday after nations failed to reach an agreement on a new climate deal as the Earth warms. The European Union and a number of countries opposed the final draft because it made no mention of fossil fuels. The effort to strip the text of references to coal, oil and gas was led by Saudi Arabia and joined by Russia. The United States did not participate in COP31.

This is Kathy Jetn̄il-Kijiner, the climate envoy for the Marshall Islands.

KATHY JETN̄IL-KIJINER: The Republic of the Marshall Islands objects to the adoption of the CMA text and cannot join consensus. We came to Antalya to honor our commitment to the Paris Agreement and to do what we promised our people back home. We face an inevitable overshoot of 1.5. We came here expecting the world to deliver a comprehensive and urgent response on reducing emissions, on protecting our people and on providing the finance to do this. We have been let down on all sides. We were presented with the worst possible response to overshoot: a response to enhance oil and gas. We will not be forced to accept false solutions. We will not compromise our future to benefit fossil fuel interests. We will not accept an outcome that undermines our security and threatens our future.

AMY GOODMAN: Ireland’s Climate Minister Darragh O’Brien outlined the European Union’s opposition to the final text.

DARRAGH O’BRIEN: At a point where the world urgently needs action to avert disastrous levels of global warming, the draft cover decision falls well short. We will not endorse a decision that does not respond to the science, that disregards the implementation gap, and that actually risks deepening the chasm between global commitments and the action required to correct the overshoot and bring 1.5 degrees back to within reach. We will not endorse a cover decision or an Antalya pact that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change. And we will not accept negotiating backward in time. And we will not accept a COP that greenwashes fossil fuel.

AMY GOODMAN: Over the weekend, climate justice activists rallied against the final text. On Friday, a Malaysian climate activist, Amalen Sathananthar, was detained after interrupting the closing plenary. He stood on a table holding a red noose around his neck and wearing a shirt that read, “You are killing the future.”

AMALEN SATHANANTHAR: You are killing the future! You are killing the future! Why don’t you just kill me now? The climate crisis is killing! … There’s no money! Just kill me now! The Global South can’t wait! The Global South can’t wait for this! And yet you just keep doing nothing, nothing at all! Racists! Kill me now! Kill me now! Kill me now! Kill me now! … You are killing the future! You are killing the future! You are killing the future! You are killing the future!

Ghassan Abu-Sittah

Harriët Bergman

,

Chihiro Geuzebroek

,

Max de Ploeg

 and the author!


In collaboration with In collaboration with Pijke ter Laak, join

Pakuis de Zwijger

 for a conversation with author Chris de Ploeg about his new book, a radical and urgent indictment of the global capitalist system and the imperial violence it unleashes upon people and planet alike. At its core, the book argues that genocide and ecocide are not tragic byproducts of capitalism – they are its fundamental features.


Together with renowned climate author Jason Hickel (in person), frontline Palestinian surgeon Ghassan Abu-Sittah (joining online) and our moderator, climate justice activist and researcher Harriët Bergman, we will dive deeper into the interconnections of the great challenges of our time–and more importantly, how to fight back. There will also be cultural performances from Chihiro Geuzebroek and brothers Chris and Max de Ploeg, tying their ancestral struggles in Bolivia and Armenia to the global struggle for liberation.
