author: CNT Sevilla
title: Entre la ignorancia y maldad
content:
“Definición: del latín definitio, -onis.

 […]

2.- f. Proposición que expone con claridad y exactitud los caracteres genéricos y diferenciales de


algo material o inmaterial.”


Definir es la asignatura pendiente de la sociedad capitalista actual. Bueno, no exactamente. Atender a las definiciones con exactitud y responsabilidad lo es. Las palabras como Feminismo, Poliamor, Política, Estoicismo, etc… Son una marabunta de ideas arremolinadas en la mente de cada cual que han sido manoseadas por tantos y cuantos idiotas hemos ido dejando opinar a nuestro alrededor, siendo muy pocas (o ninguna) las veces que hemos permitido que alguien avezado/a y conocedor/a nos ilustrase en ello. Esto no ocurre sólo con grandes ideas sacadas de algún manual de filosofía para 2º de bachillerato. Esto ocurre con las cosas más tontas y rutinarias de nuestras vidas.


Es en las definiciones cuando realmente encontramos la raíz de cada tema y nos forjamos una visión responsable y madura del mismo.


No soy filólogo, y aunque me divierte como al que más el debate de dónde nacen las palabras (¿surgen de la necesidad social o derivan a ésta?), lo que no se puede evitar reconocer es que existen y delimitan algo. Si vas a una página cualquiera del diccionario y eliges una palabra al azar, como la de la cita más arriba, su definición te dirá lo que es, y a la misma vez lo que no es. Esto cobra sentido cuando lo piensas durante un momento: especifica lo que es, y, por ende, lo que

no

 es.


Pero entonces ¿por qué según a quién preguntes sobre una definición te dice una cosa y otra? ¿Estás diciendo que todos somos unos ignorantes? ¿Significa que para ser una persona responsable debería conocer todas las definiciones de todas las cosas?


Pues es que la cosa está entre la ignorancia y la maldad, sinceramente. Aunque no me refiero sólo a la nuestra.


Decía George Lakoff en su libro «No pienses en un Elefante», que toda palabra tiene en nuestro cerebro un marco cognitivo. Propio al cerebro de cada cual. Así que cuando alguien te habla de la Libertad, pues a cada cual le sale un conjunto personal de ideas. El concepto de Libertad no es igual el que tiene un niño palestino que sobrevive en el West Bank a los bombardeos de los colonos sionistas, que el concepto de Libertad que maneja una mujer blanca adinerada de Washington DC. Y como no son iguales, cada cual reacciona a las palabras de diferente forma, sí.


Esto es inevitable y además no es malo per se. Quicir, todos nos vemos abocados a vivir, experimentar, errar y asumir; y todo esto enriquece nuestros marcos de cada una de las palabras que usamos (y también en cada idioma que usamos). Es parte de la plasticidad cerebral, y nos da margen para mejorar.


PERO.


El problema llega cuando no somos diligentes a la hora de gestionar dichos marcos y subcontratamos nuestras ideas por las de alguien más, en específico, alguien más tonto o malvado.


Durante años vamos apartando trabajar en las definiciones de las cosas complejas. O durante la ESO, o en la facultad, o en las discusiones familiares. Es que cansa. Y surgen en debates demasiado personales. Nuestros marcos cognitivos personales chocan con los de nuestra interlocutora/o, pero difieren en cosas tan sutiles y complejas que el debate se complica, y claro; ¿quién quiere tener debates sesudos un domingo por la tarde estando en casa de mamá para comer? ¿Quién quiere utilizar el tiempo de descanso tras un turno de 9 horas para discutir con su pareja sobre el alcance de la cultura machista en el ámbito de la investigación farmacéutica? No es culpa nuestra, la vida tiene muchas cosas por hacer y la media de personas trabajadoras bastante tenemos con mantener la poca cordura que manejamos. Suele ser más fácil transformar estos debates en discusiones socráticas enfocadas en el “o gano yo o él”, o ver un vídeo en una red social que suene a cómo yo pienso sobre algo.


El ignorante


Y he aquí el problema. Cuando en lugar de leer la definición de lo que es y no es el tema de se habla, pues dejamos espacio a que cualquiera nos deje sus ideas en nuestros marcos. Es decir, cambiamos nuestras experiencias, opinión y libre pensamiento por las ideas de otra persona. Y la amplia cantidad de veces, sin siquiera macerarlo o pasar nuestras conclusiones por el Departamento de Montaje. Bombardeo de ideas tontas o malvadas en redes sociales, comentarios estúpidos junto a la máquina del café en la oficina, o tu cuñado cuando opina de lo que jamás experimentó. Nos …

author: Unknown
title: Festina Lente: "Lez bike, lê hêdî hêdî" an jî "Hêdî hêdî lez bike"
content:
“Tiştê ku bi lez tê avakirin, mayînde nabe; lê tiştê ku bi aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê tê avakirin, dikare bibe bingeha pêşerojeke mayînde.”


Di jiyana mirovan de her dem xwestekek heye ku em bigihîjin tiştên ku em dixwazin. Mirov dixwaze pêş bikeve, biguherê, bigihîje armancên xwe û di jiyana xwe de encamên mezin bistîne. Ev xwestek di xwezaya mirovan de heye. Lê pir caran di nav vê xwestekê de em rastiyeke girîng ji bîr dikin: Her tişt bi lez nayê bidestxistin û her gava bilez ne gaveke pêşketinê ye.


Em di serdemekê de dijîn ku her tişt dixwaze zû pêk were. Dem, zext, pêşbazî û xwesteka gihîştina encaman, mirovan dikin ku bêyî ku pir li ser encamên tevgerên xwe bifikirin, gav bavêjin. Lê jiyan, bi taybetî jiyana civakî, her tim bi lez û bez nayê rêvebirin. Tiştên ku bingehên wan kûr in, pêdiviya wan bi dem, sebr, aqil û têgihiştinê heye.


Festina lente

 gotineke Latînî ye ku wateya wê “

Hêdî hêdî bileze

” an jî “Bilez be, lê bi sebr û hişmendî tevbigere” ye. Ev gotin di xwe de paradoksekê, ango dijberiyeke xuya, dihewîne. Lê dema em kûrtir li wateya wê dinêrin, dibînin ku ev gotin ne tenê şêwazeke tevgerê ye, belkî felsefeyeke jiyanê ye.


Festina lente ji me re dibêje ku mirov divê di armancên xwe de biryardar û bi cesaret be, lê di rêya gihîştina wan de ji aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê dûr nekeve. Bilezbûn divê bi bêaqilî re neyê tevlihevkirin. Lez divê bi rêxistin, hesab, nirxandin û berpirsiyariyê re be. Ji ber ku a girîng ne tenê ew e ku em bigihîjin armancekê, a girîng ew e ku em bi çi awayî digihîjin wê armancê.


Di jiyanê de hin dem hene ku pêdivî bi bilez tevger kirinê heye. Hin dem jî hene ku rawestan, fikirîn û li ser biryarên xwe ji nû ve nihêrîn pêwîst e. Mirovê ku van her du deman baş nas dike, dikare bi awayekî serkeftî jiyana xwe birêve bibe.


Lezkirin carinan mirovan dixe nav biryarên şaş. Mirov bêyî ku şert û mercan baş binirxîne, ji aliyê hestên xwe ve tê birêvebirin. Lê sebra bêarmanc jî dikare bibe sedema rawestan û windakirina derfetên girîng. Ji ber vê yekê pêdivî bi hevsengiyekê heye: Ne bilezbûneke bêhiş û ne jî sebreke bêdawî; lê tevgeriyeke bi armanc, bi aqil û bi berpirsiyarî.


Festina lente hunera dîtina vê hevsengiyê ye. Ew hînî me dike ku kengê divê em gavên xwe bilez bikin û kengê divê em rawestin û ji nû ve bifikirin.


Ev felsefe tenê ji bo jiyana kesane nîne. Di jiyana civakî û di pêvajoyên guherînê de jî xwedî wateyeke kûr e.


Civak bi biryarên yek an çend kesan nayê avakirin. Civak ji mirovan, bîranînên wan, êşên wan, hêviyên wan, çand, ziman, nirx û têkiliyên wan pêk tê. Dema ku civakek derbasî pêvajoyeke nû dibe, divê hem rabirdûya xwe nas bike û hem jî pêşeroja xwe bi awayekî hişmendî ava bike.


Ji nû ve avakirina civakê tenê guhertina saziyên heyî nîne. Ew di heman demê de ji nû ve avakirina têkiliyên mirovan, zêdekirina baweriyê, bihêzkirina hişmendiya hevpar û pêşxistina çandeke nû ya hevjiyanê ye.


Civakek ku bi salan rastî şer, pevçûn, cudahî, bêbawerî û birîndarî bûye, nikare bi biryarekê hemû birînên xwe bide başkirin. Ji bo vê yekê pêdivî bi dem, guhdarîkirin, naskirina êşên hevdu, vegotina rastiyan û avakirina baweriyê heye.


Bawerî bi gotinan tenê nayê avakirin; bi tevgerên rast, bi edaletê, bi wekheviyê û bi berpirsiyariyê tê avakirin. Ji ber vê yekê pêvajoyên aştiyê divê ne tenê li ser peyman û biryarên siyasî bimînin, lê divê di nav civakê de jî bingehekî xurt bistînin.


Aştî tenê rawestandina şer û bêdengiya çekan nîne. Aştiya rastîn ew e ku mirov bikaribe bê tirs bijî, mafên xwe biparêze, bi nasname û çanda xwe bijî, bi dengê xwe bêje û bi kesên din re di çarçoveya rêzgirtin û wekheviyê de hevjiyanê bike.


Aştî pêvajoyeke civakî, exlaqî û mirovî ye. Ew pêdivî bi guhdarîkirina hevdu, qebûlkirina cudahiyan, edalet, maf û azadiyên bingehîn heye. Di vê pêvajoyê de divê mirov ji hişmendiya dijminatiyê derbasî hişmendiya hevjiyanê bibe.


Lê ev guherîn bi zorê û bi lez pêk nayê. Mirov nikare ji civakekê ku bi salan di nav bêbaweriyê de jiyaye, bixwaze ku di demeke kurt de hemû tiştan ji bîr bike. Divê êş bê guhdarîkirin, birîn bêne nasîn, bêedaletî bêne nirxandin û ji bo siberojeke dadwer  bê vekirin.


Li vir jî Festina lente wateya xwe dide: Ji bo avakirina aştiyê lez bike, lê ewqas jî hişmend be ku bingeha wê bi bawerî, edalet û rêzgirtinê were avakirin.


Her guherîneke mayînde berî her tiştî di hişmendiya mirovan de dest pê dike. Mirov divê pêşî xwe biguherîne, paşê dikare têkiliyên xwe û cîhana derdora xwe jî biguherîne.


Hînkirin û perwerdehiya civakî …

author: Duda Sousa
title: Agenda da semana: Câmara vota ajuste fiscal de Lula e STF debate direitos indígenas
content:
A Câmara dos Deputados começa a semana com a apreciação e votação do polêmico pacote de ajuste fiscal apresentado pelo governo Lula.

 O presidente da Casa, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), convocou uma sessão extraordinária para esta segunda-feira (23), às 18h, com o objetivo de iniciar a análise do

Projeto de Lei Complementar

 (PLP) 299/2026, aprovado pelo Senado na última quarta-feira (18). O governo pretende concluir a votação na Câmara sem alterações no texto, evitando que a proposta precise retornar aos senadores.


Conhecido como plano Moretti, em referência ao ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, o projeto amplia os mecanismos de controle das despesas públicas. Entre as medidas estão a possibilidade de novos bloqueios de recursos, a redução de benefícios tributários e a diminuição, em determinadas condições, do limite de crescimento real dos gastos federais de 2,5% para 2%. O governo estima que as mudanças possam melhorar o resultado das contas públicas em até R$ 56,1 bilhões em 2027.


No Senado, a Comissão de Educação e Cultura deve discutir, na quarta-feira (25), as prioridades orçamentárias para a educação em 2027.

 Até o meio-dia desta segunda, os parlamentares poderão apresentar sugestões de emendas à Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias (LDO), que orienta a elaboração do orçamento federal. Encerrado esse prazo, caberá à comissão analisar as propostas recebidas e decidir quais serão aprovadas para encaminhamento à Comissão Mista de Orçamento do Congresso Nacional.


No Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), os ministros têm julgamentos previstos para quarta e quinta-feira, dias 25 e 26, envolvendo direitos dos povos indígenas e proteção ambiental.

Uma das ações questiona a exigência de consulta prévia às comunidades indígenas antes da realização de obras públicas que possam afetá-las, como a construção de estradas e a instalação de redes de energia elétrica. A Corte também deverá analisar dispositivos da Lei da Liberdade Econômica que permitem a autorização de atividades mesmo diante de possíveis impactos socioambientais. Outro julgamento previsto envolve as regras para a execução obrigatória de emendas parlamentares nos orçamentos estaduais.


De volta ao Brasil após compromissos internacionais, Lula terá pela frente as negociações para aprovar o ajuste fiscal e as articulações sobre a composição do governo para seu próximo mandato. Na última quinta-feira (19), o presidente assinou o decreto que regulamenta a nova escala de trabalho de cinco dias de atividade e dois de descanso, encerrando a

escala 6×1

. A implementação da medida e a tramitação das propostas econômicas continuam entre os principais desafios políticos do Planalto.


Estão na agenda da semana de 23 a 27 de novembro:


DIREITOS HUMANOS


Câmara


Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade (CPOVOS, 24/11, 15h30):

 A Comissão realiza audiência pública sobre a criação de uma Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade. O debate abordará políticas de memória, justiça e reparação pelas violações de direitos cometidas contra povos indígenas, além de medidas para evitar que esses episódios se repitam. 


Violência sexual infantil e inteligência artificial (CEXEXPLO, 25/11, 14h):

 Audiência discute o uso de tecnologias para produzir e compartilhar materiais de abuso sexual infantil, incluindo imagens geradas por inteligência artificial. Representantes da Polícia Federal, do Unicef e de organizações de proteção à infância foram convidados para o debate.


Rede de proteção à infância (CEXEXPLO, 26/11, 9h):

 A comissão debate a distribuição e o funcionamento dos serviços de proteção de crianças e adolescentes no país. A audiência abordará a atuação dos conselhos tutelares, dos Centros de Referência Especializados de Assistência Social (Creas) e das delegacias especializadas, incluindo as dificuldades de atendimento em regiões com menor presença dessas instituições.


Mães atípicas (CDHMIR, 26/11, 14h):

 Parlamentares debatem as dificuldades enfrentadas por mães de pessoas com deficiência. A audiência, solicitada pela deputada Erika Kokay (PT-DF), terá representantes de movimentos sociais e órgãos públicos para discutir políticas de cuidado e proteção social.


MEIO AMBIENTE


Câmara


Educação ambiental e mudanças climáticas (CMADS, 26/11, 14h):

 A Comissão realiza seminário sobre o papel da educação ambiental no enfrentamento das emergências climáticas e dos eventos extremos no Brasil. O debate contará com representantes do Ministério do Meio …

author: Unknown
title: Adresse à notre bon maître La Boétie
content:
La Boétie, un moyen pour la bourgeoisie de se défausser sur le peuple de ses propres crimes et iniquités.


Dans la présentation de l'édition chez Payot (1976) du Discours de la servitude volontaire, Miguel Abensour et Marcel Gauchet commencent par noter que ce texte est considéré comme «

 

transparent quant au sens

 

». «

 

Présupposé de lecture universellement admis, ajoutent-ils. Machiavel vient-il en question, par exemple, il est classique de s'interroger pour décider s'il écrit à l'intention des tyrans ou, à l'inverse, de ceux qui ne savent pas afin de les éclairer. S'agissant de La Boétie, par contre, il n'y aurait pas lieu de se perdre en conjectures sur le sens de sa démonstration, ni sur les destinataires du Discours. Sans équivoque aucune, La Boétie écrirait du côté de la démocratie pour le peuple.

 

»


C'est ainsi donc que revoilà La Boétie sur les barricades. Enfin, son nom. Et le titre de son discours. Car La Boétie, lui, n'est jamais descendu dans la rue pour protester, ni pacifiquement, ni violemment. Il n'a non plus jamais eu faim, jamais eu besoin de travailler dur pour gagner sa vie, jamais eu de famille à prendre en charge, jamais eu à manquer d'un enseignement de qualité. Il est né dans une famille de magistrats, il a fait de brillantes études, bénéficié d'une dérogation du roi pour entrer comme conseiller au Parlement de Bordeaux deux ans avant l'âge légal. Il n'est donc pas surprenant qu'il trouve «

 

chose vraiment surprenante

 

» que «

 

tant d'hommes, tant de villes, tant de nations supportent quelquefois tout d'un Tyran seul, qui n'a de puissance que celle qu'on lui donne, qui n'a pouvoir de leur nuire qu'autant qu'ils veulent bien l'endurer.

 

» Car lui n'a connu que les privilèges de sa condition.


Désolée cher Étienne si bien né, si bien intentionné, mais apprends un peu la vie du peuple avant de parler. On voit bien que tu n'as pas été réprimé, violenté, mutilé, persécuté, torturé ou assassiné par les polices, les milices et les armées d'un tyran, pour penser qu'il est seul et sans pouvoir contre le peuple. Tu vois Étienne, ce qui me dérange, c'est que, n'ayant jamais eu à subir ce genre de choses – tant mieux pour toi

 

! – tu vois les peuples comme «

 

des millions de millions d'hommes, misérablement asservis, et soumis tête baissée, à un joug déplorable, non qu'ils y soient contraints par une force majeure, mais parce qu'ils sont fascinés et, pour ainsi dire, ensorcelés par le seul nom d'un

 

». Pardon pour ma familiarité, monsieur de La Boétie, mais je voudrais t'y voir, toi

 

!


Pourtant tu n'as pas complètement tort. Je vois bien que, fascinés par ton seul nom, passé de génération en génération sans que personne, comme le notent les préfaciers précités, n'interroge vraiment ta parole, certains aspirants révolutionnaires se soumettent à ton autorité, parce que les y embrigadent d'autres prestigieux personnages, qu'ils soient intellectuels, leaders politiques ou simplement professeurs chargés d'enseigner à des lycéens le programme, dont tu fais partie (crois-moi, tu ne serais pas au programme si le ministère te percevait comme dangereux pour l'ordre établi

 

!). Je dis bien certains et non pas tous les révolutionnaires. Car la vérité c'est que les vrais révolutionnaires, ceux qui agissent, se soucient peu de te lire, ou de s'entendre dire par toi qu'il suffit de vouloir être libre pour l'être – alors que pour libérer l'humanité ils endurent des difficultés dont tu n'as pas la moindre idée.


Il paraît que tu as écrit ton brillant petit texte à peine sorti de l'adolescence. Un garçon intelligent, nul doute là-dessus. Né et grandi à l'abri de tout. Avec un tout petit peu d'expérience de la vie, comment aurais-tu pu écrire des choses aussi naïves

 

? Croire que le tyran est seul contre tous, et que puisqu'il est «

 

le plus efféminé de la nation

 

», il est aisé de le faire tomber

 

! Mon ami, on voit que tu n'as jamais été une femme, ni un pauvre, ni un colonisé. Tu donnes des leçons de révolution comme les curés donnent aux jeunes mariés des leçons de sexualité. Dommage que tu n'aies pu rencontrer Rimbaud plutôt que Montaigne : il a su plus tard, lui, qu' «

 

on n'est pas sérieux quand on a dix-sept ans

 

». Mais non, ce n'est pas de ta faute. La faute en est aux adultes qui continuent à te prendre au sérieux quand ils prétendent défendre le peuple alors que dans ta naïveté d'enfant gâté, tu ne fais que culpabiliser le peuple en le …

author: Unknown
title: Les Bestiales #3 du 24 février au 1er mars 2027 à Bure (55)
content:
Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes qui auront lieu à Bure en Meuse (55). Bure est un lieu de lutte contre un projet de méga-poubelle nucléaire.


Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes. Les deux premières éditions ont eu lieu en 2023 et en 2025 à Bure. La troisième édition aura lieu du 24 février au 1

er

 mars 2027 également à Bure, plus précisément à la maison de résistance à la poubelle nucléaire, 2 rue de l'Église 55290 Bure.


Les luttes ont tendance à être vues sous des angles purement utilitariste vis à vis des êtres humain.es. alors que les grands projets de bétonisation se font au détriment des espèces qui vivent déjà dans ces environnements et contribuent à détruire les espaces de vie, de trajet, d'alimentation de tout les animaux. En projetant de sacrifier tout un territoire à la folie nucléaire sans tenir compte de tou.tes ses habitant.es – humain.es et non humain.es -, le projet de poubelle nucléaire à Bure s'inscrit complètement dans une vision spéciste. C'est pourquoi les Bestiales reviennent à Bure après les deux premières éditions en 2023 et 2025.


Nous avons l'impression qu'au milieu des urgences écologiques, antifascistes, décoloniales, etc, il est parfois dur de prendre le temps de discuter/réfléchir/agir sur des luttes tout autant centrales et entremêlées telles que l'antispécisme (et l'antinucléaire). En hiver, il fait froid, il ne se passe pas grand-chose, alors pourquoi pas se retrouver en Meuse pour se rencontrer, partager, échanger autour de l'antispécisme

 

?


Nous voyons le spécisme comme une oppression systémique qui se nourrit et qui nourrit d'autres oppressions, imbriquées les unes aux autres, aussi, nos envies pour ces rencontres est d'avoir une approche anti-autoritaire, anticapitaliste et une organisation autogestionnaire. Une attention sera portée à ne pas véhiculer d'oppressions systémiques.


Toutes les informations utiles pour venir à l'événement (infos pratiques, programmation, accessibilité) sont sur notre site bureburebure.info :

les bestiales #3 sur bureburebure

. On peut y trouver notamment un formulaire de préinscription anonyme et facultatif accessible en suivant ce lien :

https://forms.42l.fr/apps/forms/is4acmzMzBxb8Ett

title: Ultimi preparativi Zapatisti per l’Incontro Abbraccio con le Famiglie Buscadoras. Parte 8: Qua e Là  Qua e Là
content:
Ultimi preparativi Zapatisti per l’Incontro Abbraccio con le Famiglie Buscadoras. Parte 8: Qua e Là

Sorelle Famiglie in Cerca di verità e giustizia:

Vi mandiamo i nostri saluti e rispetti.

Credo che questo sia l’ultimo testo che pubblichiamo prima della partenza. La delegazione ha terminato i preparativi ed è tornata a casa per salutare tutti e sbrigare le ultime faccende.

Siamo già impegnati a preparare tutto e a organizzarci per partire il 28 novembre alla volta di Città del Messico.

Prima, il 27 novembre, presso il CIDECI di San Cristóbal de las Casas, avremo i primi incontri riservati con i collettivi e le Familias Buscadoras in Chiapas.

Ecco quindi come stanno le cose ad oggi:

La delegazione zapatista si concentrerà al CIDECI il 26 novembre e ci organizzeremo per la prima sessione il 27 e per partire il 28.

Familias Buscadoras registrate presso il Frayba: 544. Si tratta di 476 donne, 63 uomini e 5 otroas. Non citeremo i nomi dei collettivi né delle persone, per tutelare la loro sicurezza a causa delle minacce che ricevono.

Si sono registrate le seguenti geografie: Jalisco, Città del Messico, Guanajuato, Tamaulipas, Coahuila, Sonora, Oaxaca, Stato del Messico, Veracruz, Colima, Michoacán, Querétaro, Baja California del Sud, Baja California, Chihuahua, Guerrero, Chiapas, Morelos, Nuevo León, Sinaloa, Puebla, San Luis Potosí, Yucatán, Aguascalientes, Quintana Roo, Nayarit e Durango.

Data di chiusura parziale delle iscrizioni: 22 novembre 2026, ore 23:59

Data di ripresa delle iscrizioni (questo avverrà quando saremo presso la base operativa a Città del Messico, nella Casa de los Pueblos “Samir Flores Soberanes”): dal 2 dicembre 2026 al 4 gennaio 2027.

È tutto. Ecco un breve video del Comando Palomitas che si è stufato di stare in fase di preparazione e ha deciso di anticipare i tempi, portando tortillas di fango, pozol, gomme da masticare e cose del genere in casse senza ruote. Hanno detto che sarebbero andati avanti a piedi. Niente paura. Non sono arrivati al cancello principale. Il motivo? Hanno finito le gomme da masticare e sono tornati indietro per rifornirsi.

Dalle montagne del Sud-est Messicano.

Video dedicato alle ballerine, ballerini e bailarinoas del Taller Coreográfico della UNAM (TCUNAM) che sono più di qualche calzamaglia, ma vabbè, pazienza. La burocrazia della UNAM sembra dimenticare che la «U» sta per università, ovvero universalità. E non avrebbero potuto avere un pubblico più degno di quello che hanno bloccato. Speriamo che ci riescano.

author: Administrador
title: Preparativi in corso laggiù.
content:
Vi informiamo di ciò che ci viene riferito, – beh, “ci viene comunicato” -, da tutto il gruppo che si sta dando da fare per rendere possibile l’abbraccio tra voi e noi, i popoli zapatisti. E tutte, tutti e todoas vi abbracciano.

Cibo. – La “Casa de los Pueblos Samir Flores Soberanes” fungerà da mensa principale per le famiglie Buscadoras, oltre ad altri due locali che sono in fase di allestimento. Non servono né generi alimentari né cuochi. Solo i soldi per l’acquisto quotidiano dei prodotti deperibili.

Trasporti. – Chi ha messo a disposizione veicolo e autista per accompagnare le famiglie buscadoras a Città del Messico, è pregato di registrarsi qui: transportegira26@gmail.com 5510175353 Con Melva Vázquez

Chiediamo a tutti gli artisti di ogni genere e a chi si occupa di sport di riprogrammare, se possibile, le proprie iniziative o di elaborarne di nuove, da realizzarsi tra il 15 e il 30 dicembre.

In quelle date avremo meno impegni e potremo unirci a voi e partecipare insieme a voi. Concerti, balli, danza, teatro, sport, partitelle, tornei di indovinelli e tutte quelle cose che voi ben conoscete. Nei luoghi che preferite e dove vi è possibile. Per quanto riguarda il trasporto, ne parleremo in seguito.

Beh, visto che ci saranno delle famiglie buscadoras da quelle parti, perché non organizzare una Posada mega-super-iper-combo con la domanda chiave: “Dove sono?”

Vedete un po’ voi. È la geografia ed è il calendario della creatività e dell’ingegno. Ognuno lo viva a modo suo. Non aspettatevi registrazioni e cose del genere. Non serve alcun permesso per l’arte e lo sport. Organizzazione collettiva e autonomia.

Dalle montagne del Sud-est Messicano.

title: Letzte zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen. Teil VIII. Hier und Dort.  An alle*.
content:
Letzte zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen. Teil VIII. Hier und Dort.

Schwestern Familien Sucherinnen von Wahrheit und Gerechtigkeit.

Schwestern*Brüder, Schwestern, Brüder.

Erhaltet unsere Grüße und unseren Respekt.

Ich glaube, das ist der letzte Text, den wir herausgeben, bevor wir fahren. Die Delegation hat ihre Vorbereitung beendet, sie sind jetzt nachhause, um sich zu verabschieden und noch Ausstehendes zu erledigen.

Wir sind damit beschäftigt, alles vorzubereiten und uns fertig zu machen, um am 28. November nach Mexiko-Stadt zu reisen.

Vorher, am 27. November, werden wir im CIDECI, in San Cristóbal de las Casas, die ersten persönlichen Treffen mit Kollektiven und Familien Sucherinnen aus Chiapas haben.

Nun teile ich Euch mit, wie es bis zum heutigen Tag aussieht:

Die zapatistische Delegation wird sich am 26. November im CIDECI sammeln, und wir werden uns für die erste Runde [der Treffen] am 27. November sowie für die Abfahrt am 28. November organisieren.

Registrierte Familien Sucherinnen via Frayba: 544. Es sind 476 Frauen, 63 Männer und 5 Otroas-AnderE. Wir werden keine Namen nennen, weder von Kollektiven noch Personen, um ihre Sicherheit zu wahren, angesichts der Drohungen, die sie erhalten.

Sie haben sich registriert aus folgenden Geographien: Jalisco, Mexiko-Stadt, Guanajuato, Tamaulipas, Coahuila, Sonora, Oaxaca, Mexiko-Bundesstaat, Veracruz, Colima, Michoacán, Querétaro, Baja California Sur, Baja California, Chihuahua, Guerrero, Chiapas, Morelos, Nuevo León, Sinaloa, Puebla, San Luis Potosí, Yucatán, Aguascalientes, Quintana Roo, Nayarit und Durango.

Datum/ Uhrzeit der zeitweisen Schließung der Registrierung:

Datum der Wiederaufnahme der Registrierung (das ist, wenn wir in der Operationsbasis in Mexiko-Stadt, in der Casa de los Pueblos »Samir Flores Soberanes« sind):

Dezember 2026 bis zum 4. Januar 2027.

Nun, das ist alles. Hier ein kleines Video vom Comando Popcorn, das sich gelangweilt hat, sich weiterhin in der Vorbereitung zu befinden und somit entschied, vorauszueilen ‒ auf einem Kisten-Karren ohne Räder Schlamm-Tortillas, Pozol, Kaugummi und solche Dinge mit sich führend. Sie sagten, sie eilen zu Fuß voraus. Keine Sorge. Sie kamen nicht bis zum Hauptportal. Der Grund dafür? Es gingen ihnen die Kaugummi-Vorräte aus und sie kehrten zurück, um sie wieder aufzustocken.

Aus den Bergen des Südosten Mexikos.

Subcomandante Insurgente Moisés. Hauptkoordinator der »Reise für das Leben. Kapitel Mexiko«. Mexiko, November 2026.

Gewidmet den Tänzerinnen, Tänzern, Tänzer*innen der choreographischen Werkstatt der UNAM (TCUNAM), die enger standen als ein Bodysuit; aber hallo, zweifellos. Die UNAM-Bürokratie hat wohl vergessen, dass das »U« von Universität, das heißt, von Universalität kommt. Sie hätten kein würdigeres Publikum haben können, als das, welches sie blockierten. Hoffentlich ist es gelungen.

title: Zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen.  Teil VII.   Hier auf dem Berg. (Wichtige Information für Transporteure und Familien Sucherinnen.)
content:
Zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen. Teil VII.

Hier auf dem Berg. (Wichtige Information für Transporteure und Familien Sucherinnen.)

Der Mond geht wie eine Sense über den Horizont und mäht Träume wie Alpträume.

Der Berg wird von einer unverschämten Sonne aufgedeckt. Er reckt und streckt sich. Nach und nach wird der fortschreitende Tag ihn enthüllen: die ausgedehnte Falte des langen, grünen Nagua-Rocks, die Waldungen der Kniemulden, die Taillen-Mitte mit der aufgeregten Menge der Vögel und anderen Tiere, die kleinen Hügel der Brüste, die sich scheu zwischen den Nebeln zeigen, sowie ein Haargewölk, dessen Scheitel ein kalter Wind der Nicht-Mehr-Morgendämmerung kämmt.

Eine alte Frau steigt einen Pfad hinab. In einer Hand hält sie einen Bund von Kräutern, ihre andere Hand hält ein kleines Mädchen, das als Dreikäsehoch den Erdboden kaum überragt.

»Diese Pflanze erleichtert Menstruationsbeschwerden. Der Berg, der wie Als Frauen, die wir sind, ist, gibt uns dieses Kraut zum Geschenk, damit wir gehen und arbeiten können und nicht wie ein leerer Kaffeesack faulenzend herumliegen müssen, mit dem Schmerz als Ausrede. Jetzt kennst du das noch nicht, aber du wirst es natürlich kennenlernen, wenn du größer bist.«

»Und das, was ich dir erzähle, hat mir meine Großmutter erzählt, und ihre Großmutter hat es ihr erzählt. Und derart viele viele Jahre, so viele Jahre, dass die Mathematiker sie nicht zählen können. Denn wir* vergehen, die Erde jedoch bleibt. Genauso verbleiben wir in Euch, den Töchtern und Enkeltöchtern. Deshalb machen wir uns Sorgen, ob Ihr esst, krank werdet oder vermisst seid. Deshalb suchen wir sie, um ihnen zu zeigen, sie zu orientieren, ihnen zu sagen, sie sollen munter guten Schrittes und guten Weges sein.«

»An uns Großmüttern ist es, aufzuzeigen; das ist unsere Arbeit. Und Ihr kleinen Mädchen, Eure Arbeit ist zu leben, zu erfahren.«

Das Mädchen nickt und betrachtet das Schreiten [ihrer Großmutter]. Sie weiß, die Großmutter hält sie nicht an der Hand, damit sie nicht verloren geht, sondern um sich zu stützen: ein lebender Stock für die alte Frau, die langsam geht.

Die Großmutter glaubt, sie unterstützt und beschützt das kleine Mädchen; das kleine Mädchen glaubt, sie unterstützt und beschützt die Großmutter.

Unten, am Fuß des Berges, wartet die Mutter in der Holzhütte auf die Kräuter, die ihr den Schmerz erleichtern werden, der in ihrem Bauch zieht und sticht.

Ein Geruch von gekochtem Mais, frischen Tortillas und glühendem Brennholz umfängt die Hütte. Vater und ältester Sohn sind bereits frühzeitig zum Mais-Bohnen-Feld gegangen, das Pozol-Mais-Getränk in ihren Morraleta-Webtaschen tragend.

Ein Baby weint, natürlich; weil es noch nicht die Worte hat, um zu sagen: »Hier bin ich«.

Denn, Freundinnen und Feindinnen, Weinen bedeutet auch ein Lebenszeichen.

Im Camp der Insurgentes gehen die Arbeiten weiter, um die Geschenke für die Mütter Sucherinnen zu machen. Da die Puppen-Herstellung im Verzug ist, hat der SubMoy angeordnet, dass einige der Männer die Schreiner-Arbeiten sein lassen und zu den Stickerei-Arbeiten überwechseln sollen.

Jedoch zuvor, als sie noch als Frauen, die wir sind unter sich waren, haben die Compañeras Insurgentas Informationen ausgetauscht. Sie erzählen vom letzten Tanz in der Comunidad der Jugendlichen in Gemeinschaftlichkeit.

Sie flüstern und lachen, während sie aus den Augenwinkeln zu den Männer schauen, welche die Holzkästchen herstellen, die dazu dienen werden, dass die Puppen während des langen Weges zur Hauptstadt nicht beschädigt werden.

»Dieser Compa«, meint eine, »kann gut [Cumbia] Sonidero tanzen; das ist eine neue Musik, die die Städter erfunden haben.« Ohne dabei aufzuhören, die Bluse zu besticken, ergänzt sie: »Heijajeih, von einer Seite zur anderen, so als ob er losfliegen würde, einfach unglaublich. Und er kritisiert die anderen, die ohne Partner*in nicht tanzen können. Das heißt, frei tanzen: Nichts da mit am Händchen führen und solche Sachen. Die anderen kritisieren ihn auch und sagen: Er tanzt ja nur Sonidero, weil er keine*n Freund*in findet.«

»Und woher weißt du das?« »Durch eine geteilte Information.« Alle lachen komplizinnenhaft. »Ich«, erzählt eine andere, »kann kaum tanzen. Niemals habe ich in meinem Dorf getanzt, ich weiß nicht, als ob es mich nicht interessiert hätte. Doch dann sagte der SubMoy, wir sollten zum Tanz gehen. Und zweifellos, dies war eine Anordnung, es musste getanzt werden. Und da war ich dann …

author: Kodao Productions
title: Gormless* Sara defense narratives
content:
At this stage, it is impossible for the defense panel of Sara Zimmerman Duterte Carpio for a reset after successive days of testimonies from their witnesses that weakened the case of their principal, antagonized the senators who are sitting in judgment of their client, and tested the credulity of the parties-in-interest to this case, the millions of citizens who are befuddled by the legal theory behind the defense.


Ranged against the findings of forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera who used a fine comb to sift through Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALNs), tax filings, documents, business registration records, bank transactions and the use of manager’s checks to hide wealth, inward remittances, corporate financial reports, and concluded under a conservative framework that Sara had amassed P817.87-million in hidden wealth. Using a broader framework, her wealth would zoom to P1.5-billion. In response to this, the other Sara defense panel in social media insisted that the amount of P817.87-million was an “invention.”


It is an “invention” that could not be pierced by the dagger of Atty. Rainer de la Fuente, which the defense presented in the hope of dismantling the testimony of Atty. Cabrera, a certified public accountant (CPA) who spent 35 years at a big-league accounting and auditing firm and even became its chairman. In contrast, Atty. de la Fuente spent 25 months at the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) where he was supposed to learn the ropes of financial investigation to ferret out fraud, money laundering and illegal transactions. Atty. de la Fuente a perfect witness, not for the defense but for the prosecution since he admitted in court that he had not read Cabrera’s report to maintain himself on an even keel, unbiased and not affected by any bias.


It is a strange testimony that immediately impeaches his relevance to the trial since he, not of a motion in **limine could not perform the duty of a witness hostile to the prosecution. Since they could no longer question the ***facticity of Cabrera’s brief, they are stuck with it, and de la Fuente’s refusal to comment on the findings of the prosecution’s expert witness. To add insult to injury, de la Fuente admitted that while two weeks is a short time to stitch together an ironclad narrative, it is possible it can be an unassailable report. Worse, de la Fuente admitted that the Sara’s documents are littered with red flags.


It was unfortunate for the defense to rely on Atty. de la Fuente as their pointman in destroying the testimony of Cabrera. By not reading the Cabrera report and not debunking it in court, the defense was left to tackle extraneous issues about money laundering, which is a matter totally different from the issue of ill-gotten wealth, a distinction that was pointed out by Rep. Chel Diokno, who invited Atty. Mark Vinluan to produce any mention of money laundering in Article 2, the remaining article for the impeachment trial, after three articles were withdrawn.


Neither were the witnesses from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) any better than Atty. de la Fuente. The DTI admitted it was not into examining the books of any company under its jurisdiction even as it confirmed that it oversees food processors exporting other markets, like China. Yet, DTI was surprised to know that Cale88 Foods had only two employees despite exporting shiploads of banana chips. It also struck the DTI that they granted export incentives to a company owned by Sara’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio, and their family dentist. It never conducted physical inspections of the Cale88 factory. Last year, without the DTI’s knowledge, the company was “sold” to Pitipong Pitipong Phils., another company owned by the Dutertes. In July 2026, all the bank accounts of Cale88 were closed in time for the impeachment trial.


It was also an ugly move for the defense to dispense with the 16 bank employees who were crucial for the defense to demolish whatever there was to demolish in the prosecution’s mountain of evidence, let alone the Cabrera report that Sara’s lawyers were not prepared to controvert. The people were denied the chance to hear it direct from the horse’s mouth, especially from a bank executive who disclosed that Sara, indeed, had dollar accounts. Adding more mystery to the defense tactics is the sudden inability of two witnesses to take the stand on Nov. 26 and 27, thus extending the trial into …

author: Acratosaurio rex
title: Las elecciones generales asimétricas
content:
Repito: que votes o no votes, a mí personalmente me da igual. Yo solo estoy dando mi opinión: Decía que los millonarios no votan y se abstienen, porque saben que su dinero, sus propiedades, sus inversiones, tienen mucha más fuerza a la hora de protegerse, que la papeleta de un pelón para designar un

diputao

. El ricachón: una llamada de teléfono, una sugerencia de sus abogados, algunos toques aquí y allí de sus esbirros, y le montan una fiesta en el Gobierno.


Compara ese esfuerzo y sus riesgos, con la que tienes que liar tú para que se den cuenta de que existes. ¿Preparaste la última Huelga General? Reuniones por doquier, preparativos, viajes aquí, vueltas allá, gastos en materiales, propaganda, abogados, logística, coordinación, legalización, más reuniones… Semanas y semanas de desgaste, acampadas… Llega el Gran Día, de noche, lloviendo, millones de personas en la calle, amenazas patronales, y te encuentras a unos pistoleros a sueldo con armadura y con un orinal en la cabeza gaseando, apaleando, pateando, empujando, deteniendo. Todo tu esfuerzo y tus riesgos de despidos, ruinas económicas, pérdidas salariales…


Para que el gobierno saliente y el entrante, unos hijos sin madre, se enteren, ¡por fin!, de que hay un problema. Para que se hable un poco del tema de la vivienda. Para que lo metan en agenda. Oh sí. 


Y entretanto, fondos, bancos, sociedades, grandes patrimonios y empresarios, hacen, deshacen, roban, manipulan, conspiran, saquean, asesinan, te cortan la garganta, exhiben sus atrofiados genitales y se forran. ¿Quiénes sois, de dónde venís, hombres inmundos? ¿Pudiera ser que surgisteis del coito casual de una garrapata y un piojo?


La verdad, como que si los ricos pensaran que las elecciones podrían hacer peligrar sus chanchullos, lo mismo hasta las prohibían. Y me da que si las dejan correr, es porque saben que no suponen riesgo alguno. ¡En serio, maldita sea! Hay que ser un completo alcornoque, un tarugo, un zoquete, para creer que en esa trampa, puede haber algo interesante, cuando lo que hay realmente, es una guerra asimétrica.

title: Iranian regime detains Hazim Haşimî in Awdanan
content:
Following protests in the Awdanan district over a traffic accident involving a bus transporting workers from the Dehloran Refinery, in which 13 workers lost their lives, the number of people detained has risen to 13.


According to Kolber News, forces affiliated with the Iranian regime, along with masked groups, raided the home and workplace of Hemze Haşimî and Hisên Haşimî in the city of Awdanan, in Ilam Province. During the raid, Hazim Haşimî was beaten and tortured before being detained without a court warrant and taken to an unknown location.


It was reported that, during Hazim Haşimî’s arrest, armed individuals pointed their weapons at his mother and demanded that she hand over her other son, Husên Haşimî. The armed individuals also reportedly threatened and assaulted other members of the family.

author: Unknown
title: Antalya’daki COP31’de anlaşma sağlanamadı
content:
Antalya’da düzenlenen ve Türkiye’nin ev sahibi olduğu Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği Konferansı'da (COP31) anlaşma sağlanamadı. COP, son 17 yıldır ilk defa anlaşma sağlanmadan sona ermiş oldu.

BBC’nin haberine göre, fosil yakıtlardan uzaklaşma taahhüdü anlaşmadan tamamen çıkarıldı. Hazırlanan dördüncü taslakta da kömür, petrol ve doğal gazdan uzaklaşılmasına ilişkin herhangi bir ifadeye yer verilmedi. Bunun üzerine Avrupa Birliği (AB), fosil yakıtlardan uzaklaşma taahhüdünün anlaşmaya yeniden eklenmesini istedi. Ancak son taslakta bu yönde bir ifade bulunmadı ve AB, metni kabul etmedi.

Petrol üreticisi ülkelerin fosil yakıtlardan uzaklaşılmasına dair taahhüde karşı çıktığı belirtildi. Suudi Arabistan öncülüğündeki petrol üreticisi ülkeler, fosil yakıtlara ilişkin ifadelerin anlaşmadan çıkarılmasını istedi. Rusya da bu talebi destekledi ve AB’yi doğrudan eleştirdi.

AB, petrol üreticisi ülkeleri müzakereleri engellemekle suçlarken, bir AB temsilcisi de bazı petrol üreticisi ülkelerin görüşmeleri kendi çıkarları doğrultusunda yönlendirdiğini ileri sürdü.

COP31'de AB heyetini temsil eden İrlanda İklim Bakanı Darragh O'Brien da, anlaşma taslağı için, "Önümüze konulan taslaklar, karşı karşıya olduğumuz iklim acil durumunu ele almaya bile başlamıyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Kapanışta konuşan Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanı Murat Kurum ise, “Salonda bu metne karşı çıkan taraflar olduğu açık. Bu belge üzerinde uzlaşı olmadığını kabul ediyoruz. Bu nedenle bu kararlar kabul edilmemiştir” dedi.

Ayrıca dünya basınında Türkiye’nin isminin çok az yer bulması da dikkat çekti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: DEM Party delegation travels to İmralı to meet with Öcalan
content:
The İmralı delegation of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) has traveled to the Turkish prison island of Imrali on Sunday to meet with Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan. The delegation consists of members of parliament Pervin Buldan and Mithat Sancar, and lawyer Faik Özgür Erol from Asrın Law Office.


The DEM Party İmralı delegation last visited Öcalan on September 13.


DEM Party Co-Chair Tuncer Bakırhan stated during his party’s parliamentary group meeting on November 17 that Öcalan had been moved to a residential area specially built for him on Imrali. Accordingly, his working conditions have also changed following the relocation. In addition, his secretarial support has been increased to enable him to work more quickly and effectively, Bakırhan stated.


The changes are linked to the ongoing peace and democratization process. In his speech, Bakırhan emphasized that, following the cessation of armed hostilities and the initiation of dialogue, the focus must now be on establishing the legal and political foundations and opening up space for democratic politics.

Speaking to ANF in Behdînan ahead of the 48th anniversary of the party’s founding, HPG and YJA-Star guerrillas said they regarded November 27 as a national festival.


Delal Çiya, Elî Dirêj, Amed Derik, and Ezîz Derwêş shared their assessments of the PKK’s influence in Kurdistan and the Middle East, the women’s movement, and the Peace and Democratic Society Process.

Thanks to the efforts of the comrades who took part in the founding of the party alongside the Leader and devoted themselves to it, the party has endured to this day, undergoing change and transformation and bringing about new developments within its own ranks. title: Sabahattin Tekin released after 30 years in prison
content:
After 30 years in prison, political prisoner Sabahattin Tekin has been released from Maltepe No. 1 L-Type Prison in Istanbul. He was welcomed outside the prison by his family, representatives of MATUHAY-DER (Marmara Association for Solidarity and Mutual Assistance with the Families of Prisoners and Convicts) and more than a hundred other people.


Immediately after his release, Tekin drew attention to the plight of ill prisoners. He stated that prison conditions were extremely harsh for many of those affected and that their immediate release was therefore necessary. He particularly highlighted the cases of 84-year-old Ali Rıza Yurtdaş and Halis Seven, both of whom remain imprisoned in Maltepe Prison.


https://video.anf-news2.com/live/firat/376d4686_20261122095937_2026-11-22-istanbul-sebahattin-tekin-30-yillik-tutsak-tahliye-edildi-1.mp4


Tekin sharply criticized the Turkish Forensic Medicine Institute, whose reports play a significant role in determining whether ill prisoners are fit to remain in detention. He described the institution’s decisions as a form of torture.


Tekin called for support for the Peace and Democratic Society Process. He stressed that democratization and the building of a democratic society continued to require collective commitment. “Our task and our responsibility are to expand this struggle,” he declared. Tekin emphasized that social resistance had given him strength throughout his three decades in prison. He also expressed his determination to continue working for democratic development and the peace process following his release.

title: Men demonstrate against violence against women in Qamişlo
content:
In Qamişlo, men organized a demonstration to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women on November 25. The demonstration highlighted society’s responsibility to combat patriarchal violence and emphasized the importance of equality and mutual respect.


Participants carried banners bearing slogans such as “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî” (Woman, Life, Freedom), “Women are the source of life,” and “When women are free, society is free.” Other slogans paid tribute to the women’s revolution in Rojava: “The Revolution of the Braids has broken the shackles of silence” and “The Revolution of the Braids continues.”


Violence against women affects society as a whole


Following the demonstration, a joint statement was read out in Kurdish by Ebas Mihemed and in Arabic by Mihemed Kozî. In the statement, participants condemned all forms of violence against women and emphasized that combating such violence is a responsibility shared by society as a whole.


“We stand up for human rights and the dignity of women. We condemn every form of violence against women. Violence is not merely an individual problem, but a social and humanitarian issue that threatens the future of society,” the statement read.


Stressing that violence violates women’s fundamental rights to life, safety, freedom, and equality, demonstrators urged families, educational institutions, civil society organizations, and all other members of society to respect and protect women’s rights and reject all forms of violence.


Silence will not end violence


The participants also emphasized the need for women and men to live together as equals, stressing that mutual respect and equality must form the foundation of social relations. In closing, they warned against allowing violence against women to persist through silence and inaction: “As long as violence is met with silence, it cannot be overcome. To put an end to violence, everyone must take responsibility and actively fight against it.”

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish women demonstrate against femicide in Düsseldorf
content:
The Kurdish women’s movement held a demonstration in Düsseldorf to draw attention to the ongoing violence against women and the rising number of femicides. Ahead of the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women on November 25, participants from various cities across North Rhine-Westphalia gathered to emphasize the collective struggle against patriarchal violence and the need for stronger organization among women.


The protest was organized by the North Rhine-Westphalia branch of the Association of Kurdish Women in Germany (YJK-E). Demonstrators carried purple flags and the colors of the Kurdish women’s movement. Banners bore slogans including “Through organized resistance, we will stop femicides and wars” and “We are ashamed of a masculinity that kills women.”


https://video.anf-news2.com/live/firat/deb67b61_20261121160534_2026-11-21-dusseldorf-25-kasim-kadina-yonelik-siddete-karsi-uluslararasi-mucadele-gunu-yuruyus-1.mp4


Murdered women remembered


Carrying portraits of revolutionaries Sakine Cansız, Fidan Doğan, Leyla Şaylemez, and Evîn Goyî, participants commemorated four members of the Kurdish freedom movement who were assassinated in politically motivated attacks in Paris. Images of other women who had been killed were also carried during the protest. The slogan “Jin, Jiyan, Azadî” (Woman, Life, Freedom) rang out repeatedly. The demonstration thus combined remembrance of murdered women with a call to organize against femicide, patriarchal structures of domination, and war.


Women’s movement announces further activities


Şevin Sincar spoke on behalf of the Kurdish women’s movement, focusing particularly on violence against women in Germany and the rising number of femicides. She also outlined planned activities as part of the campaign against violence against women and femicide. Sincar emphasized that combating patriarchal violence must not be limited to individual days of protest. She stressed the importance of raising awareness across society, expanding solidarity networks, and strengthening the organized women’s struggle. The women’s movement said it would continue its activities against femicide and male violence in the coming period.

The İmralı delegation of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) had a meeting with Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan on the Turkish prison island of Imrali on Sunday.


The delegation consisted of members of parliament Pervin Buldan and Mithat Sancar, and lawyer Faik Özgür Erol from Asrın Law Office.


The DEM Party İmralı delegation is expected to make a statement about the meeting tomorrow.


DEM Party Co-Chair Tuncer Bakırhan stated during his party’s parliamentary group meeting on November 17 that Öcalan had been moved to a residential area specially built for him on Imrali. Accordingly, his working conditions have also changed following the relocation. In addition, his secretarial support has been increased to enable him to work more quickly and effectively, Bakırhan stated.


The changes are linked to the ongoing peace and democratization process. In his speech, Bakırhan emphasized that, following the cessation of armed hostilities and the initiation of dialogue, the focus must now be on establishing the legal and political foundations and opening up space for democratic politics.

The Press and Liaison Center of the East Kurdistan Defense Units (YRK) issued a statement providing information about ongoing attacks by the Iranian regime in East Kurdistan (Rojhilat).


According to the statement on Sunday, the Iranian regime has once again bombarded the Serçûrî district of Merîwan using drones and 120 mm mortars. It said the attacks were launched from the military base in the village of Derê and surrounding positions.


According to the statement, the attacks caused damage to the local environment, landscape, natural resources, and wildlife.


The YRK confirmed that no fatalities occurred in their ranks as a result of the attacks.

title: Protest against two years of state-appointed trustees in Dersim
content:
A rally was held in Seyîd Riza Square in Dersim (Turkish: Tunceli) to mark the second anniversary of the appointment of state-appointed trustees to the municipalities of Dersim and Ovacık district. The demonstration was organized by the Labor and Democracy Platform and attended by local residents and representatives of political parties and civil society organizations. Participants demanded the removal of the trustees and the reinstatement of the democratically elected municipal administrations.


“Social peace cannot be achieved through the appointment of trustees”


Demonstrators carried a banner reading: “The appointment of trustees is an attack on the will of the people and public resources. We do not accept it.” The platform’s joint statement was read out by Özcan Ateş, Co-Chair of the DEM Party’s provincial branch in Dersim. He criticized the fact that the democratically expressed will of the people of Dersim and Ovacık had been disregarded for two years.


Referring to the ongoing Peace and Democratic Society Process, Ateş stated that ending the system of trustees was a necessary prerequisite for credible democratization. “Peace can only be achieved if democratic rights are genuinely guaranteed. Without recognizing the will of the people, a democratic society cannot be built. Social peace cannot be achieved through the policy of appointing trustees,” Ateş emphasized.


Birsen Orhan: State-appointed trustees must be removed


Birsen Orhan, the elected Co-Mayor of Dersim who was replaced by a state-appointed trustee, then took the floor. She criticized the consequences of two years of trustee administration, highlighting in particular the dismissal of municipal employees who have been unable to return to their jobs despite court rulings.


Orhan also recalled the case of Gülistan Doku, a university student who disappeared in 2020 and whose fate has remained a matter of concern for the people of Dersim for years. Tuncay Sonel, the governor and state-appointed trustee at the time, is currently in pretrial detention in connection with the suspected femicide of the then 21-year-old woman.


“For two years, the will of the people has been disregarded, and this disregard is even being portrayed as a success story,” Orhan said. She stressed that respecting democratic decisions was a fundamental prerequisite for the ongoing peace process. “The appointment of trustees contradicts the spirit of this process, and these administrations must be revoked.”


Trustee administration also targets identity


The ousted Co-Mayor Cevdet Konak also offered a critical assessment of the state-appointed administration in Dersim. He said the past two years had been marked by losses and institutional decline. He stressed that the interventions had targeted not only the elected municipal representatives but also the city’s social and cultural identity.


“The trustee administration was also imposed on the language, identity, faith, and memory of Dersim. Decisions are being made without transparency and with the public excluded from the process,” Konak stated. He demanded public accountability for the past two years: “Disclose what you have done over these two years. Can you do that? No, you cannot. You talk about the public interest and building trust. Why, then, have you closed the places where the people of Dersim could express themselves?”


Konak pointed to the contradiction between the peace process and continued state control over municipalities. “While we are engaged in a peace process, our will continues to be overridden by a state-appointed trustee. We say: Restore our democratic self-governance and remove the trustees.”


Criticism of environmental destruction and economic interests


Mustafa Sarıgül, the elected Mayor of Ovacık who was replaced by a state-appointed trustee, recalled that municipal officials had been elected to office by the people. “Only the people can remove us from office,” he declared.


Sarıgül noted that they had worked to protect the language, nature, and social identity of their region during their time in office. He particularly criticized the ongoing destruction of Dersim’s natural environment and the commercial exploitation of its landscape.

author: CMI Argentina
title: A pedido de Trump, el Senado argentino sancionó la adhesión al Tratado de Patentes
content:
Advierten por aumentos de hasta 40% en medicamentos y señalaron que perjudica la producción argentina de medicamentos genéricos.


El Senado sancionó finalmente la adhesión al Tratado de Cooperación en Materia de Patentes (PCT), solicitado al Gobierno argentino desde los Estados Unidos, por 47 votos a favor, 22 en contra y ninguna abstención durante la sesión de este jueves.


Desde la oposición señalaron que la aprobación afecta la producción local de medicamentos genéricos, que habrá subas de hasta el 40% en el precio de los medicamentos y que se habilita un negocio para las multinacionales internacionales en el área de Salud.


La ley de Adhesión al Tratado Internacional de Patentes era uno de los puntos que el presidente estadounidense le impuso a Javier Milei como condición para que el Tesoro de ese país le preste 20 mil millones de dólares a la Argentina para sanear su crisis financiera.


Pues bien, la Cámara alta había aprobado el proyecto en 1998, es decir, hace 28 años. Sin embargo, recién este año el oficialismo desempolvó ese expediente -que no caducó, según lo establecido por la Ley 13.640 en cuanto a tratados internacionales-, a raíz de los compromisos asumidos por el acuerdo comercial firmado con la gestión de Donald Trump.


Las modificaciones


Sin embargo, en agosto pasado el texto fue devuelto desde la Cámara de Diputados al Senado por una modificación: la reserva del Capítulo II, que es el que habilita exámenes internacionales (no vinculantes) sobre los requisitos de patentabilidad de la invención. Esto fue a pedido de la industria farmacéutica argentina.


Argentina era hasta hoy uno de los pocos países de la región que todavía no había adherido al PCT. El tratado establece que una vez registrada una patente por un país miembro, ésta tendrá validez automática durante 20 años en el resto de las naciones adheridas, que hasta ahora eran 158.


Desde el Gobierno destacaron que, con la adhesión al PCT, “los innovadores argentinos ganarán en tiempo, burocracia y costos, dado que actualmente deben iniciar el trámite de patentamiento desde el exterior, por no contar el país con una oficina receptora”.


 


 


El argumento del Gobierno para que avance la ley


El PCT fue suscripto en Washington el 19 de junio de 1970, enmendado el 28 de septiembre de 1979 y modificado el 3 de febrero de 1984 y el 3 de octubre de 2001.


El objeto del tratado es facilitar la presentación internacional de solicitudes de patentes mediante un procedimiento unificado de presentación, búsqueda y publicación.


Prevé un sistema para iniciar el procedimiento internacional mediante una única solicitud, estandarizar requisitos formales, obtener una búsqueda internacional, acceder a información preliminar para evaluar la patentabilidad de la invención y diferir ciertos costos asociados a la tramitación en cada jurisdicción, como traducciones, tasas nacionales y designación de mandatarios locales.


Además, preserva la competencia de los Estados para establecer y aplicar sus propios criterios sustantivos de patentabilidad.


Detalles del debate


Como miembro informante, el senador libertario Francisco Paoltroni ponderó que finalmente se llegara a este momento de tratar el tratado al que, resaltó, “han adherido 159 países. Argentina no pertenecía a este grupo hasta el día de hoy. Acompañar este tratado es entender hacia dónde va el mundo y hacia dónde queremos llevar definitivamente a la Argentina”.


Resaltó que antes obligaban a tramitar las patentes a través de socios extranjeros por no ser parte del sistema. “Esta aprobación es un mensaje clave y potente hacia el exterior y hacia adentro -continuó-. La Argentina abraza la previsibilidad jurídica, respeta las reglas de juego, la economía del conocimiento y le da herramientas legales a su entramado productivo para generar valor, empleo genuino y divisas”.


A continuación, el catamarqueño Guillermo Andrada anunció en nombre de Convicción Federal su apoyo al tratado “básicamente porque aquellos investigadores van a tener que hacer menos trámites. Van a poder incorporarse al mundo con su patente, haciendo ventanilla única y simplificando el trámite”.


Con esta aprobación tendrán más tiempo que el que le daba al país el Convenio de París para que una vez inscripta esa patente, pueda ser evaluada y la persona que genera el pedido pueda conseguir financiamiento para esa patente, resaltó el senador.


Medicamentos 40% más caros

“La brutalidad policial y lo arbitrario del procedimiento no pueden ser explicados sino como un mensaje para amedrentar a quienes, con su compromiso, siguen luchando por verdad y justicia en los Juicios de Lesa Humanidad. author: Juanpablo Ramirez-Franco
title: Experts Urge EPA to Tackle Public Health Crisis of Nitrates in Drinking Water
content:
A 2019 study estimated that up to 12,594 new cancer cases each year are attributable to nitrate in drinking water.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

When the federal government set its limit on how much nitrate drinking water can safely contain, the primary concern was blue baby syndrome, a condition that deprives infants of oxygen. In the 51 years since then, research has associated exposure to the contaminant with cancer and other health problems, fueling calls for a stricter standard.

On Monday, a coalition of national and local advocacy organizations including the Natural Resources Defense Council, Union of Concerned Scientists, Prairie Rivers Network, and 11 others filed a petition calling on the U.S Environmental Protection Agency to lower that threshold from 10 milligrams per liter to 1 mg/liter. In its petition, the coalition argued that “nitrates in drinking water are causing a public health crisis across the country.”

“One in three Americans — nearly 120 million people in this country — are currently being served water with dangerous levels of nitrate in it,” said Tyler Lobdell, a senior staff attorney at Food & Water Watch. That figure includes people served water with nitrate concentrations above 1 mg/L — one-tenth of the current federal standard.

Nitrate pollution, much of it linked to fertilizer and manure runoff and leaching from agriculture, is a particular concern in farming regions, where contaminated groundwater can disproportionately impact rural, low-income, Latino, and farmworker communities. Studies have linked exposure with colorectal cancer, thyroid disease, and fetal abnormalities. A 2019 study estimated that up to 12,594 new cancer cases each year are attributable to nitrate in drinking water.

“This change would reflect the best available, peer-reviewed science and would bring substantial health benefits to communities across the country,” according to the petition.

Climate change can exacerbate nitrate contamination as increasingly intense rainfall and flooding washes fertilizer and manure into waterways and groundwater. Drought can concentrate pollutants.

In a statement to Grist, the EPA wrote that it would review the petition but noted that it completed its review of drinking water regulations, including the nitrate standard, in July 2024.

“EPA conducted a robust evaluation of available studies and applicable data for nitrate to determine if any new information provided a basis to support a regulatory revision that would improve or strengthen public health protection,” the statement read. “Based on the agency’s review, EPA determined that the nitrate rule was not a candidate for revision at the time.”

As part of the petition, the organizations commissioned the consulting firm One Water Econ to analyze the costs and benefits of adopting the proposed standard, especially in states most affected by nitrate contamination.

The 43-page report found that slashing the threshold isn’t cheap. The report estimates that adopting the 1mg/L benchmark would cost $94.5 billion over 50 years, which would cover everything from upgrading water treatment plants, maintenance, and replacing equipment. Despite the steep price tag, the analysis found that returns would significantly outweigh the investment, the benefits totaling $364 billion.

“People are paying with their health right now,” Lobdell said. “Costs are accruing right now in the real world, in the form of people losing their loved ones and children being born with abnormalities.”

The states with the largest impacted populations tend to cluster in the West and Midwest and account for 62 percent of the affected population, according to the analysis. Agricultural powerhouses like California, Texas, and Arizona topped that list, with traditional farming states like Iowa not far behind.

In Iowa, approximately 42 percent of residents are exposed to nitrate levels above 1 mg/L, according to the analysis. This summer, Des Moines-area residents faced water restrictions for the second year in a row amid high nitrate levels. Illinois faces a similar problem. Between 2021 and 2023, more than 2 million people were served drinking water that tested above 1 mg/l, said Robert Hirschfeld, the director of water policy at Prairie Rivers Network.

title: Inflación: de eso no se habla porque los números siguen siendo horribles
content:
Panorama económico actualizado al 21.11.2026


“Los números siguen siendo horribles, pero la película es la mejor película de la historia”


Mario Hernandez


Afirmó el jefe de Estado al referirse a los indicadores sociales durante una entrevista con Fernando González, publicada por El Observador, en Madrid. Según planteó, durante los 30 meses de su gobierno, la pobreza pasó del 57% al 32%, mientras que la indigencia se redujo al 7% y el porcentaje de niños pobres descendió del 70% al 42%.


“Creer que podés arreglar todo en cuatro años, o en ocho años, es mentirle a la gente”, dijo Milei (sic). En ese sentido, aseguró que está cumpliendo los objetivos que se había propuesto en materia de crecimiento económico y reducción de la inflación.


El mandatario también reconoció que le gustaría que la recuperación avanzara a mayor velocidad. “La dirección es la correcta. Ahora, me gustaría que fuera mucho más rápido. Podríamos ser mucho más rápidos”, admitió. Sin embargo, otra vez, justificó las dificultades para acelerar el proceso al señalar que el Gobierno debe afrontar las consecuencias de las políticas económicas anteriores y los efectos del contexto internacional.


Al explicar por qué todavía hay argentinos que no logran llegar a fin de mes, Milei culpó al “populismo” que consumió el capital disponible. Y argumentó que ahora es necesario reconstruirlo mediante inversiones, ahorro y mejoras en la productividad.


Inflación: de eso no se habla


Luego de que se conociera un salto en la inflación al 2,2%, lejos del “cero” que prometió, el presidente Javier Milei participó el jueves 12 de noviembre de la Gala Endeavor Argentina 2026. En su discurso eligió no hacer ninguna mención al dato del IPC y se limitó a prometer más apertura económica y a defender el avance de la Inteligencia Artificial.


“Hay que ampliar ese tamaño de mercado para potenciar los rendimientos crecientes y acelerar el crecimiento de la economía; lo que hacemos desde el Ministerio de Desregulación, quitando regulaciones, y desde el Ministerio de Capital Humano, otra de las grandes fuentes del crecimiento económico”, planteó.


Y continuó: “Cuando llegamos al Gobierno, llegábamos a menos del 10% de la población del planeta. Hoy abrimos más de 500 mercados y llegamos al 30%. Estamos trabajando fuertemente y nuestra idea es llegar, de acá a 2031, al 90% del planeta. Argentina tiene un coeficiente de apertura de 30% y debería tener uno de 90%”.


El mandatario no hizo ninguna mención para justificar ni explicar el índice de 2,2 por ciento de inflación de octubre, algo que sí intentó en X su ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo.


Caputo eligió destacar una baja de la inflación calificada como núcleo y atribuyó la suba en el IPC a los cambios en el Régimen de Zona Fría y su incidencia en las variables de vivienda, agua, electricidad, gas y otros combustibles.


Atrás quedó su vaticinio del 14 de abril pasado, cuando prometió que los siguientes 18 meses serían “los mejores que Argentina haya visto en las últimas décadas”.


En su discurso, el Presidente tampoco habló de la reciente visita del papa León XIV y hasta incluso pareció contradecirlo al ensalzar el rol de la inteligencia artificial.


Milei repitió en su exposición su argumento de que la innovación no destruye puestos laborales. “La tecnología multiplica lo que un hombre produce en una hora de trabajo. Esa productividad se traduce en salarios más altos, en productos más baratos y así cosas que antes eran un lujo hoy se encuentran al alcance de cualquiera”, sostuvo.


En esa línea, aseguró que el crecimiento “termina llegando a todos y, sobre todo, a los más pobres, los que más ganan cuando todo se abarata”.


Sobre la carrera global en el rubro de la IA, dijo que “Argentina tiene todo para ser protagonista” porque “somos un país con energía, minerales y talento, y un gobierno que decidió sacar las trabas del camino”.


Lejos de la postura optimista de Milei, el Papa habló del tema en su conferencia en la UCA y planteó que “los desafíos de la inteligencia artificial y de la automatización desregulada pueden poner en riesgo tantos puestos de trabajo y convertirse en una verdadera amenaza para el adecuado desarrollo humano integral”.

title: Our World Order Is Collapsing in Real Time
content:
Everyone agrees the West is in decline. But who’s really to blame? Owen Jones has the answers in his new book, The Fall of the West: How They Really Lost It. In conversation with Ash Sarkar, with a live audience at EartH Hackney, Jones traces a line from the collapse of the Soviet Union through to the atrocity of the Israeli genocide of the Palestinians, and Donald Trump’s military defeat by Iran.


The idea that the West had reached ‘the end of history’, Jones argues, led to concentrations of power and political complacency which in turn sowed the seeds of inevitable decline.


How is Jones measuring collapse, and is it relative to China or absolute? Is the persecution of the pro-Palestine movement really ‘worse than McCarthyism’? And in a week where David Walliams and Russell Brand’s behaviour in the noughties is finally catching up with them, how does Jones reflect on the legacies of Little Britain and his book Chavs, 15 years after it was published?

author: Jessica Corbett
title: Trump Order Aims to Restrict What Federal Contractors Can Tell Congress
content:
The move was widely seen as part of a broader effort by the president to obstruct Democrats’ planned probes.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

With Democratic leaders promising “accountability” when the party takes over the US Senate and House of Representatives in January, Republican President Donald Trump late Friday signed an executive order directing federal contractors and subcontractors to notify the White House before sharing information with Congress and withhold anything his administration deems confidential.

Any contractor or subcontractor that fails to comply could face “potential termination or cancellation of contracts,” the order says.

The White House claimed that “Trump is ensuring that Americans’ confidential information and national and homeland security work is protected, and that the executive branch is able to serve the American people efficiently and economically.”

Major news: President Trump has signed an executive order requiring federal contractors to notify and coordinate with the executive branch on congressional oversight asks. Democrats have vowed to make defense contractors a major target next year. https://t.co/MMeFhNJWDy

However, his move was widely seen as part of a broader effort by the president to limit Democrats’ planned probes into not only the federal government and its contractors but also Trump and businesses that may have benefited from his return to power.

Acknowledging the anticipated Democrat-led investigations, the White House fact sheet says that “certain congressional leaders have threatened to intrude on these executive prerogatives by seeking confidential executive branch information from executive agencies and harassing private companies that contract with the federal government.”

Lisa Gilbert, co-president of of the watchdog group Public Citizen, stressed in a Saturday statement that “contractors are paid with Americans’ tax money and must be the best for the job, full stop.”

“However, throughout the Trump administration we’ve seen widespread abuse of the contracting process, with lucrative contracts doled out to political allies, inexperienced startups, and flatly unqualified bidders, for everything from major ICE operations to Trump’s vanity projects,” she noted, referring to US Immigration and Customs Enforcement. “No-bid and emergency awards have become the norm, circumventing rules designed to prevent corrupt contracting.”

“The new Congress rightfully has its sites set on this obvious cronyism for investigation and oversight,” she continued. “The American people have a right to know how their money is being spent, that it is going to capable contractors, and that is not be used to reward allies and punish perceived enemies.”

Gilbert added that the new order, “dressed up in fancy talk about executive privilege and enhancing efficiencies, is nothing but a naked ploy to try and protect the perpetrators of this corruption. It will not succeed. Sunlight is coming and corrupt administration insiders and contractors, both, will have to face the American people.”

Friday’s order follows a directive issued this week by White House Counsel Will Scharf requiring federal agencies to obtain White House approval before employees agree to testify before Congress. Scharf said certain Democratic investigations could amount to criminal conduct, a claim that has raised questions about the administration’s attempts to limit congressional oversight.“

The restrictions could face legal challenges, particularly if contractors are told to withhold information sought through congressional subpoenas. Executive privilege allows presidents to protect certain confidential communications, but courts can ⁠intervene in disputes over Congress’ authority to obtain information.

Robert Garcia (D-Calif.), who is expected to lead the House Oversight Committee, sent document preservation letters to a dozen current and former Trump administration officials, and Rep. title: KULTUR DER UNREGIERBARKEIT
content:
Neue Bucherscheinung bei Unrast Verlag: Dieses Buch benennt die Leerstellen anarchistischer Praxis: Organisation als Selbstzweck, fehlende Kontinuität, soziale Isolation. Eine Intervention in die Bewegung, die benennt, warum wir uns selbst blockieren und was sich ändern muss.


In den letzten zwanzig Jahren haben Anarchist*innen entscheidend dazu beigetragen, Widerstand über Kipppunkte hinaus in offene Aufstände zu treiben – in Ägypten, Hongkong, Katalonien, Griechenland, Frankreich, den USA, Mexiko, Chile oder Brasilien. Zugleich sind sie immer wieder hinter ihren gesellschaftlichen Möglichkeiten zurückgeblieben, haben vorhersehbare Gefahren nicht erkannt oder waren nicht in der Lage, die nächsten Schritte zu gehen.


Dieses Buch benennt die dabei in den Blick geratenen Leerstellen anarchistischer Praxis: Viele dieser Niederlagen lassen sich auf ungelöste Fragen von Organisation, Kontinuität und Gemeinschaft zurückführen. Die anarchistische Bewegung fetischisiert Organisation, anstatt sie als begrenztes Werkzeug zu begreifen; sie versteht nicht, warum sie sich von Generation zu Generation immer wieder neu erfindet und dabei ähnliche Fehler wiederholt; und sie unterschätzt ihre Isolation – eine Isolation, die ihre Handlungsfähigkeit einschränkt und sie anfällig für Repression macht.


Falsche Bescheidenheit hat die Bewegung daran gehindert, zu erkennen, wie wirksam sie tatsächlich war, während ihr Ego die Bewegten blind für die systematischen Fehler gemacht hat, mit denen sie revolutionäre Situationen immer wieder verspielen. Peter Gelderloos fordert dazu auf: Es ist Zeit, die Dinge klar zu sehen!
